chapters.title: Chapter 3980: Choices and Consequences! II
paragraphs: The confession pulsed in the white-gold space between them!
This was the voice of someone who had watched a being they cared for suffer unimaginable loss, and who would do anything to prevent such tragedy from occurring again!
Anything.
Maybe even...Everything?
Noah’s eyes shone brightly as he thought of many things.
He listened to this powerful being...one whose standing was among the greatest, with imposing calm.
His expression remained thoughtful as he absorbed every word, every nuance of meaning that colored her speech!
When she finished, he was about to shake his head, to deflect her questions with the same mysterious evasions he had employed thus far.
But in the next moment, Duke Gwendolyn’s gaze changed with the suddenness of glory!
Her expression shifted from concerned inquiry to profound shock, her eyes widening as if she had just been told or shown something heavy!
Her entire bearing transformed, authority giving way to alarm as information flooded her consciousness through channels that existed beyond his perception.
Noah felt surprise flicker through his own awareness as he witnessed this dramatic change.
"What happened?" he asked, his voice carrying genuine curiosity.
Duke Gwendolyn looked at him briefly, her expression cycling through thoughts as if she were debating whether to share.
Her eyes shone with inner light as decision crystallized into action, and when she spoke again, her voice carried somber weight!

"The reason I am so cautious about every variable, every unknown factor that enters our calculations," she said, her words measured with careful precision, "is because so many unprecedented events have been occurring over the last few hundred years. Things that show us something unknown is approaching, something that threatens the very foundations of how existence operates."
She waved her hands with movements that carried the authority to alter existence itself, and in response to her gesture, a massive illusory screen bloomed behind her in the white-gold expanse!
The surface rippled with images that seemed to exist in multiple dimensions simultaneously, displaying scenes from across the breadth of existence itself.

"Living Existences are dying at rates that would have been unthinkable in previous eras," she continued, "More Inevitabilities manifest with each passing day, their numbers growing exponentially as if something is deliberately feeding the chaos and Paradox that spawns them. Every force that promotes stability becomes weaker while everything that encourages destruction grows stronger."

"This is why Order is so important," Duke Gwendolyn said, her gaze finding Noah’s with intensity. "Why the Young Miss represents hope that transcends personal attachment. She could be one of the core answers to all of this chaos, one of the few remaining forces capable of imposing structure upon entropy."
As she spoke these words, her expression shifted once more as new information flooded her consciousness. Her eyes blazed with the light of someone receiving reports from across impossible distances!

"And just now," she said, her voice taking on notes of somberness that made the white-gold space around them tremble, "I have received information about a different type of chaos blooming in the Transcendent Temporal Folds. Groups of terrifying... Dead Existences have been sighted for the first time in many years."
HUUM!
Noah’s weavings buzzed.

"There are Living Existences," she said, her voice growing more somber with each word, "and there are Dead Existences. Not the pathetic creatures that Fold Dwellers sometimes call ’Dead Things’...beings who have no true understanding of what death actually means, who play at darkness while remaining fundamentally, inescapably half alive."
The screen behind her shifted again, displaying images that made Noah’s enhanced perception recoil involuntarily.
Here were entities that existed in states so antithetical to life that merely observing them challenged the very concept of existence itself!

"Dead Existences," Duke Gwendolyn continued, "dissolve Living Existential Authority through simple proximity. They devour everything that possesses the spark of consciousness, feeding upon the very essence of what it means to exist. Their presence transforms thriving Folds into voids where even the memory of life becomes impossible to maintain."
Her voice took on the cadence of someone reciting records that most preferred to forget.

"Throughout the vast majority of existence’s history, Dead Existences and Living Existences have barely interacted. Not through choice or mutual agreement, but because THE Creature...worked to keep the two sides separated."
As she spoke, the screen behind them displayed scenes from the Transcendent Temporal Folds that challenged Noah’s ability to process what he was witnessing!
Eerie figures moved through landscapes of purple-blue rivers with a synchronization.

They walked in perfect formation, their heads raised toward skies that held no stars, their movements carrying the mechanical precision of entities that had long since forgotten what individual will meant.
But it was their feeding that truly captured Noah’s horrified and glorious attention.
Their mouths pulsed with rhythms that seemed to echo the heartbeat of death itself, opening wide to reveal voids that contained nothing...actual nothing that hurt to perceive directly!
From these impossible maws came a suction that drew in the brilliant purple-blue rivers of temporal authority that flowed through the Temporal Folds like the lifeblood of reality itself.

They devoured time. They consumed the very essence of causality, their feeding transforming the carefully maintained streams of temporal energy into voids where cause and effect ceased to have meaning!
The massive tear that had allowed their entry into the Temporal Folds pulsed with deathly authority that made the surrounding space convulse in recognition of something that should not exist.
From its edges seeped energies that transformed everything they touched, turning vibrant rivers of temporal power into stagnant pools of crystallized ending.
But even as Noah struggled to process the implications of what he was witnessing, the scene on the screen took a turn toward something infinitely more terrifying.
"SKEE!"
A sound erupted from the display...not quite a scream, not quite a roar, but something that existed in the space between meaning and madness.
It was the audible representation of entropy given voice, a cry that seemed to originate from the concept of ending itself!
From the tear in reality, a massive obsidian hand began to emerge with the deliberate certainty of nightmare.
The appendage was composed of what appeared to be fossilized bones, each finger larger than ancient towers!
The aura it radiated...
Even here, in this protected space between existence, even filtered through the barrier of the illusory screen, the presence of that emerging hand caused Duke Gwendolyn to fall silent.
Her ancient eyes widened with recognition of power that approached her own magnitude...authority that operated on the level of Dukes!
"Motherfucker," she uttered with cold precision, the profanity carrying more weight than most formal proclamations!
This was something even she had not anticipated, a development that challenged calculations!
Her frown deepened as she turned toward Noah, her expression growing more grave with each passing moment.

"The Dukes of the Living Temporals have sent word demanding that the Coalition of Living Existences deploy all available forces to close this torn Veil of Existence," she said. "Every free Honored and Prime Living Existences must converge on the Temporal Folds before this breach expands beyond our ability to contain it."
Noah blinked, his mind working through the implications.

"Why did they not send Honored and Royal Living Temporals the moment they discovered the breach?" he asked, "Why allow things to escalate to this point when immediate action might have prevented the situation from becoming dire?"

chapters.title: Chapter 3981: Choices and Consequences! III
paragraphs: The question struck at the heart of Duke Gwendolyn’s growing seriousness.
Her expression became somber as she prepared to reveal information!
Heavy information!

"Because," she said, her voice carrying the weight of someone admitting to fundamental weakness, "a single Honored Dead Existence can easily overwhelm ten Honored Living Existences in direct combat. The power disparity is not merely significant...it is absolute, insurmountable through normal means."
She paused.

"All Dead Existences are inherently fortified by traces of something that very few even know about, much less understand. Because of events that occurred during the Earliest Folds...catastrophes that reshaped the fundamental nature of existence itself, every Dead Existence carries within their being an active Curse. This Curse makes their existence unbearable, transforms every moment of their awareness into agony beyond description, but it also elevates their power far beyond what any Living Existence can achieve."
Noah’s eyes visibly shone as he absorbed this information, though he carefully kept his excitement from showing on his features.
The mention of a Curse that operated on such a fundamental level, that could reshape the basic parameters of existence itself...

"This Curse," Duke Gwendolyn continued, her voice dropping to barely above a whisper, "stems from something called a Lost Forgotten Principle. Its name is the Infinite Paradox of Unmaking...the authority to exist in a state of perpetual ending without ever achieving the release of true death. It grants them power that exceeds every normal limitation while simultaneously ensuring that they can never find peace, never escape the agony of their condition."
HUUM!
She paused, her expression growing even more grave.
"Its roots trace back to THE Paradox itself, and the first time when the Creature...expressed wrath!"
The revelation struck Noah like lightning!
The connections, the implications, the vast web of cause and effect that stretched back to the earliest moments of existence itself...

"All Living Existences," Duke Gwendolyn continued, "apart from one specific type, are badly outmatched against Dead Existences. The Curse that empowers them operates according to principles that make normal authority irrelevant, normal resistance meaningless. The only Living Existences whose nature allows them to offset this fundamental disadvantage, whose very essence provides some measure of protection against the simple Curse of the Infinite Paradox of Unmaking..."
She paused, her ancient eyes finding Noah’s with intensity.
"Are Living Paradoxes."
WAA!
The words hung in the white-gold space between them like a revelation.
Noah felt his mind racing through possibilities even as he maintained his expression of calm interest.
"When," he asked, his voice carefully neutral, "was the last time Living Paradoxes worked with the other Living Existences?"
Duke Gwendolyn did not reply immediately.
Her silence stretched across moments that felt like eons, carrying within it the weight of truths too heavy to voice easily.
Because the answer was clear to anyone who understood the fundamental hostilities that had shaped existence for countless ages.
Never.
The answer was never, or so rarely that the exceptions proved the rule rather than challenged it.

Noah’s eyes blazed as he contemplated all the possibilities that this revelation opened, his gaze shifting to the screen behind Duke Gwendolyn where the situation in the Temporal Folds continued to deteriorate with each passing moment.

The rupture was expanding now, its edges torn wider by forces that operated from within the realm of endings. Through the growing breach, more of that terrifying presence began to emerge...not just the massive obsidian hand, but hints of what lay beyond it.
A skull began to peek through the widening tear, its ancient and terrifying stature emanating eons of existence spent in states that challenged every definition of consciousness.

Empty sockets gazed out from bone that seemed to have been carved from crystallized despair, while flames burned within those voids...the cold illumination that spoke to light that had learned to hate its own existence!
The skull was massive, dwarfing even the obsidian hand that had preceded it.
Its presence radiated authority that made even Duke Gwendolyn’s power seem diminished by comparison!

In the next moment, with movements that carried the weight of inevitability itself, the skull tilted forward and the rupture shattered completely. Reality tore like fabric being ripped by hands that possessed the strength to unmake the fundamental structure of existence itself!
The massive form that stepped through the breach defied every attempt at description.
It was skeleton and void, ancient bone and crystallized ending, intelligence and entropy given shape and purpose.
Its power seemed utterly horrific as it eclipsed that of even a normal Duke, operating on levels that challenged the Folds themselves!
Duke Gwendolyn gazed upon this manifestation of ultimate ending with expressions that cycled through shock, alarm, and calculation.

"That torn Veil of Existence needs to be closed before any more truly powerful Dead Existences emerge," she said, her voice carrying the urgency of someone who understood that failure here would mean catastrophe!
Noah looked at the screen, at the impossible being that had emerged from a place where ending was not conclusion but ongoing state, and felt understanding crystallize into opportunity.
Glorious fucking opportunity!

"If Paradoxes are ideal when fighting against these entities," he said, his eyes shining with possibilities that stretched toward horizons Duke Gwendolyn could not yet perceive, "then I could provide an Honored Living Paradox to help with this situation, even if a little."
Duke Gwendolyn’s eyes flashed sharply at these words, her ancient mind immediately focusing on implications about every assumption she had made about Noah’s true nature and resources.
Noah scoffed at her expression, his voice carrying amusement mixed with gentle reproach.
"You possess another body that operates as a Living Paradox," he pointed out with casual logic, "yet you find it impossible to believe that I might have an Honored Living Paradox under my employ?"
The challenge was delivered with such matter-of-fact certainty that it forced Duke Gwendolyn to confront the contradictions in her own thinking.
She stared at Noah with stern intensity, her voice carrying weight!
"You’re supposed to be...a mere Fold Dweller," she said, each word carefully measured and heavy.
Noah’s smile deepened as understanding bloomed between them.
"I am," he said, "a particularly strong, rich, and well-connected Fold Dweller."
He paused, allowing this redefinition to settle before continuing with words that carried the weight of genuine offer.

"Give me the location where this catastrophe is unfolding in the Temporal Folds, and I will send my Honored Living Paradox there immediately. You can even deploy your disguised second body alongside mine and claim that both of them operate under your direct control. I’m certain that Living Existences have captured and enslaved Paradoxes for their own purposes over the years, yes?"
Duke Gwendolyn considered this proposal with the careful attention of someone weighing variables.
Her ancient mind worked through possibilities and consequences, calculating risks against potential benefits!
After a moment that felt like eternity compressed into heartbeats, she spoke.
"Okay."
A simple word. A calm agreement. Yet it carried within its single syllable the weight of alliances forming, of barriers being crossed!
Noah’s smile grew even brighter as he absorbed the implications of her acceptance, his mind already racing through the many possibilities that this single word had opened.
Many more opportunities had just presented themselves, pathways toward advancement and understanding that stretched toward horizons he was only beginning to perceive!
In the white-gold space between existence, two beings of immense power had just forged an understanding.
And in the distance, through tears in reality itself, Dead Existences continued their advance into the Transcendent Temporal Folds!

chapters.title: Chapter 3982: Choices and Consequences! IV
paragraphs: Existence was vast.
Unfathomably, incomprehensibly vast.
The chaos unfolding in the Transcendent Temporal Folds, where Dead Existences emerged from tears in reality itself, was but a single thread in an infinite weaving.
The wonder echoing through Aeternitas Concordia as the Weaver of Existence conducted his trades was merely another note in a symphony that stretched across dimensions without end.
Both events, momentous though they were to those who witnessed them, represented only fractional facets of the unfathomably vast network of weavings that comprised existence itself!

While some beings across the breadth of reality felt tremors of chaos rippling, while others sensed the approach of forces that challenged the nature of what it meant to be alive, there existed countless quintillions of beings within quintillions of Omniverses nested inside Wheels of Existence who continued to live in perfect peace.
They had no idea what was happening beyond their small corners of reality. To them, existence remained stable, predictable, safe.

They loved and laughed and dreamed and died according to patterns that had governed their ancestors for eons, blissfully unaware that the very foundations of order trembled beneath forces too vast for their comprehension!

Then there were those who knew exactly what was happening across the breadth of existence...who understood the magnitude of the chaos, who perceived the approaching storms, and yet still lived in a manner that would be the envy of Living Existences.
Such beings could be found in the Early Veiled Shore.
Here, where golden sands stretched beneath skies of crystalline perfection, the very concept of worry seemed alien and unwelcome.
The Shore had evolved far beyond its original Budding state, transforming into something that approached the mythical gardens spoken of in the Stories of the Earliest Folds.
The sands themselves pulsed with inner radiance, each grain containing within it the compressed essence of advancement itself!

Where Noah’s feet had touched the Shore during his meditations, the sands glowed with deeper intensity, as if they remembered the presence of an Early Creature and sought to honor that memory through perpetual illumination.
Nine ancient trees dotted the landscape with spacing that suggested careful planning rather than random growth.
Their trunks rose toward the sky, the branches that spread from these magnificent giants seemed almost ready to bear fruit...produce that pulsed with its own inner authority!
Between the trees and the golden sands, the radiant white-blue waters of the Early Sacred Waters struck the shores in waves.
Each surge and retreat created music that resonated throughout, the sound of crystalline purity meeting primal earth resounding.
Throughout this paradise, Sacred Totems rose like monuments to impossible achievement!

Each structure blazed with its own unique radiance...cerulean for Infinity, gold for Protagonist, deep purple for Tyranny, their crystalline surfaces reflecting and amplifying the ambient authority until the very air seemed thick with liquid Living Existential Authority.
At the edges of this impossible realm, mist wrapped around the vast Shore itself like protective veils woven from compressed possibility.
Through this barrier, nothing could pass without invitation, a boundary that protected this sanctuary from the chaos that raged across the breadth of existence.
Everything about the Early Veiled Shore spoke to pristine perfection!
It was in this setting of impossible tranquility that Noah opened his eyes and rose from his seated position upon the golden sands.
Ancient pulses of archaic power erupted from his body with each step, waves of authority so concentrated they created visible distortions in the air around him.
The golden sands beneath his feet glowed brighter in response to his movement, while the crystalline waters seemed to lean toward the shore as if drawn by gravitational forces around him!
His bare upper body bore the accumulated markings of his advancement...Early Living Existential Glyphs that pulsed with their own inner radiance.

The continued devouring of nutrients from the compressed Inevitability through the Early Veiled Shore’s mystical processes had caused his power to scale exponentially, each passing moment bringing new heights of capability!
His bearing was becoming explosive in its intensity.

He felt his Resistances coursing through his being like liquid starlight flowing through crystalline channels. The percentage of total collective Resistances had exceeded 1,000%, yet this felt like only the beginning of.
Though he possessed the ability to form his own Resistance, a gift granted by the First part of his Heart of an Early Creature, he waited with patient anticipation.
He wanted a Resistance based not on normal principles or conventional understanding, but upon a Lost Forgotten Principle itself!
Such a foundation would grant him protection that transcended every normal category of defense, making him nearly invulnerable.

But he did not yet possess a shred of a Lost Forgotten Principle. He could not forge a resistance from nothing, could not base ultimate protection upon concepts that remained incomplete within his understanding.
So he waited, and continued walking across the glorious sands with steps that left glowing impressions in his wake.

At this moment, his collective power had crossed 450 million in both Complexity and Purity Quotients...achievements that placed him firmly within the beginning tides of the Early Throne Ascendancy Realm of his own exclusive progression.

Yet even now, he refrained from using his accumulated CQ and PQ to form an Eminent Early Living Existential Glyph. The temptation was considerable...such power would grant him capabilities that could challenge Living Existences, but he waited.
He was saving his resources for a single, glorious expenditure...the formation of a Kleos Glyph!
Because Kleos was truly astonishing in ways that Eminent could never match, representing perfection of concept given form and purpose.
His feet came to a stop before a figure that commanded attention through sheer presence alone.
Moiraine sat upon the vibrant sands in meditative stillness, yet every line of her form spoke to barely contained majesty!
Nine winged halos rotated around her head with subtle movements.
Yet even these marvels paled beside the true testament to her advancement.

In addition to the more than 400 Eminent Early Living Existential Glyphs of Paradox that adorned her form like constellations of compressed authority, she now bore ten Kleos Glyphs of Paradoxical Genesis across her body.
Ten!
These ultimate expressions of power appeared as tribal tattoos that made her look simultaneously wild and royal, primal and refined. Each Kleos Glyph was a masterwork of existential artistry.
They blazed with authority that made the surrounding air tremble.

The first Glyph spiraled around her left arm like a serpent of compressed paradox, its coils containing within them the essence of contradiction itself. The second traced patterns across her shoulder blades that resembled wings made from crystallized impossibility, while the third created a crown of authority around her brow that spoke to dominion over forces that defied comprehension.
Each marking told its own story of transcendence, yet together they formed a symphony of power!
They made her appear as something that had stepped from the earliest epochs of existence, when power flowed according to principles that current reality had forgotten.

Her eyes opened as Noah approached, revealing orbs that blazed with the accumulated light of paradox refined into perfect harmony. When she looked at him, her gaze carried warmth wrapped in respect, affection disguised as formality.
"I have ten formed," she said, "and I can-"
Before she could continue, Noah raised his hand with a gesture that carried the weight of absolute command.
"Save them all for now," he said, "as it seems you will need all the power you can gather for your first outing."
The words struck Moiraine with the force of revelation, her eyes widening as understanding bloomed within her consciousness!
She rose from her meditative position with fluid grace, her movements causing the Kleos Glyphs to pulse with synchronized brilliance as anticipation flooded through her being.

Would he finally have her make a move? Would she at last be permitted to demonstrate the full extent of her accumulated power? Who would he have her eliminate? Paradoxes who had dared to oppose him? Origins who had failed to show proper respect?
Her eyes shone with enthusiasm that bordered on bloodlust as she awaited his command!

sentences.text: Existence was vast.
Unfathomably, incomprehensibly vast.
The chaos unfolding in the Transcendent Temporal Folds, where Dead Existences emerged from tears in reality itself, was but a single thread in an infinite weaving.
The wonder echoing through Aeternitas Concordia as the Weaver of Existence conducted his trades was merely another note in a symphony that stretched across dimensions without end.
Both events, momentous though they were to those who witnessed them, represented only fractional facets of the unfathomably vast network of weavings that comprised existence itself!

While some beings across the breadth of reality felt tremors of chaos rippling, while others sensed the approach of forces that challenged the nature of what it meant to be alive, there existed countless quintillions of beings within quintillions of Omniverses nested inside Wheels of Existence who continued to live in perfect peace.
They had no idea what was happening beyond their small corners of reality.
To them, existence remained stable, predictable, safe.

They loved and laughed and dreamed and died according to patterns that had governed their ancestors for eons, blissfully unaware that the very foundations of order trembled beneath forces too vast for their comprehension!

Then there were those who knew exactly what was happening across the breadth of existence...who understood the magnitude of the chaos, who perceived the approaching storms, and yet still lived in a manner that would be the envy of Living Existences.
Such beings could be found in the Early Veiled Shore.
Here, where golden sands stretched beneath skies of crystalline perfection, the very concept of worry seemed alien and unwelcome.
The Shore had evolved far beyond its original Budding state, transforming into something that approached the mythical gardens spoken of in the Stories of the Earliest Folds.
The sands themselves pulsed with inner radiance, each grain containing within it the compressed essence of advancement itself!

Where Noah’s feet had touched the Shore during his meditations, the sands glowed with deeper intensity, as if they remembered the presence of an Early Creature and sought to honor that memory through perpetual illumination.
Nine ancient trees dotted the landscape with spacing that suggested careful planning rather than random growth.
Their trunks rose toward the sky, the branches that spread from these magnificent giants seemed almost ready to bear fruit...produce that pulsed with its own inner authority!
Between the trees and the golden sands, the radiant white-blue waters of the Early Sacred Waters struck the shores in waves.
Each surge and retreat created music that resonated throughout, the sound of crystalline purity meeting primal earth resounding.
Throughout this paradise, Sacred Totems rose like monuments to impossible achievement!

Each structure blazed with its own unique radiance...cerulean for Infinity, gold for Protagonist, deep purple for Tyranny, their crystalline surfaces reflecting and amplifying the ambient authority until the very air seemed thick with liquid Living Existential Authority.
At the edges of this impossible realm, mist wrapped around the vast Shore itself like protective veils woven from compressed possibility.
Through this barrier, nothing could pass without invitation, a boundary that protected this sanctuary from the chaos that raged across the breadth of existence.

chapters.title: Chapter 3983: Choices and Consequences! V
paragraphs: Toward her gaze filled with eager anticipation, Noah smiled with an expression that carried layers of meaning she was only beginning to perceive.

"You may actually die if you aren’t careful," he said, his words delivered with calm certainty that sent chills through her enhanced consciousness, "as the place you are going already has an enemy that multiple Dukes may have to stand together against. So... I will come with you."
The statement struck Moiraine heavily, alarm flooding through her features as she shook her head with incredulous disbelief!
Her mind raced through possibilities, each one more disturbing than the last as she struggled to process what he was suggesting.
"What place is this?" she demanded, "And Sir, you are... much weaker than me, you know? Maybe stay here, and I will brave everything myself."
Her words were straightforward and majestic, carrying within them genuine concern that transcended every protocol of respect or deference.
She was no longer afraid of speaking her mind when his safety was at stake, her loyalty expressing itself through protective instincts that overrode every other consideration.
She thought of him first before anything else, prioritizing his wellbeing over her own advancement or the completion of whatever mission he might have in mind!
Noah’s smile deepened at her response. Yet his decision remained unchanged, crystallized through calculations that took into account variables she could not yet perceive.
"I want to see as well," he said, "so get as powerful as possible to protect me...we will leave shortly."

With those words hanging in the crystalline air between them, Noah turned away from her position and moved across the golden sands toward the cultivation plots where seeds had been planted with careful precision.

Behind him, Moiraine settled back onto the vibrant sands with stern determination written across her features. If he insisted on placing himself in danger, then she would forge at least one more Kleos Glyph of Paradoxical Genesis before they departed.
Every additional layer of protection she could provide might mean the difference between his survival and catastrophe.

Noah approached the cultivation plots with steps that left glowing impressions in the golden sands, his enhanced perception taking in every detail of the agricultural paradise that had been created through his blood and careful planning.
The plots themselves were marvels, each one carved from the blessed earth through the sacrifice of his essence as an Early Creature!
Within these blessed rectangles of earth, the seeds of Auric Vitae Grass had been planted with spacing that suggested careful attention to optimal growing conditions.

Though still in their earliest stages of development, the seeds had already begun to respond. Tiny shoots of green-gold vegetation pushed through the radiant soil like fingers reaching toward light, their surfaces already displaying the characteristic shimmer that marked them as something beyond normal plant life.
The sight of them filled Noah with satisfaction as this was the foundation upon which he would build advancement that could rival the greatest achievements of the Earliest Folds.

Beside the plots, Heidrun lounged with the casual arrogance that had become her trademark. Her lustrous white fur caught and reflected the golden light of the Shore until she appeared to be carved from compressed starlight itself, while her crystalline eyes regarded the emerging vegetation with obvious pride and anticipation.

The magnificent goat had positioned herself with strategic precision, close enough to the plots to discourage any other being from approaching her future delicacies, yet far enough away to maintain an air of imperial detachment.
Noah approached her position and reached out to stroke her head, his fingers running through fur that felt like silk woven from pure light.

Heidrun allowed the gesture with regal tolerance, raising her head with expressions of pride and arrogance that somehow managed to convey gratitude without diminishing her imperial bearing in the slightest!

Satisfied with this moment of connection, Noah turned his attention to the real purpose of his approach. He waved his hands with movements that carried the authority to reshape reality itself, calling forth treasures that had been acquired through careful trade in the markets of Aeternitas Concordia.
The herbs materialized in the space before him like offerings presented to existence itself, each one blazing with its own unique signature of power and potential.
The moment these precious specimens entered the atmosphere of the Early Veiled Shore, reality itself seemed to take notice of their presence!

|Multiple cultivation-ready specimens have been detected within the Early Veiled Shore’s domain. Transcendent Veilmoss, Chronos Petrichor, Void-Heart Chrysanthemums, Echo Sage, and Infinity’s Breath Orchids have been identified as compatible for planting.|
HUUM!

|To properly establish cultivation plots for specimens of this magnitude, the sacrifice of Early Creature Blood will be required. Recommended allocation: 180 drops per standard plot for Transcendent-grade specimens, 250 drops per plot for Temporal-sensitive varieties, 150 drops for Void-attuned species.|
|Current specimens require a total of 580 drops of Early Creature Blood to establish proper cultivation environments. Proceed with plot establishment?|
Noah smiled at the cascade of information, his eyes shining with anticipation as he absorbed the implications of what these herbs could provide.
"Take whatever is needed," he said.

The response was immediate and visceral. His skin split open along precise lines that followed the natural flow of authority through his enhanced physiology, allowing drops of crimson-gold blood to flow forth with the stately grace of liquid starlight.

Each drop that emerged carried within it the compressed essence of what it meant to be an Early Creature, potential so concentrated that Existence itself seemed to bend around their passage through the air.
Where each drop touched the blessed earth of the Shore, transformation began immediately.

The golden sands shifted and reformed, their very nature being rewritten by the influence of Early Creature essence. Square plots of fertile land rose from the Shore itself, their surfaces shining with white-gold radiance.
The sight was magnificent to behold...blood given freely for the purpose of creation rather than destruction!
With the plots established and pulsing with readiness, Noah began the careful process of planting each precious specimen with his own hands.

The Transcendent Veilmoss went into the first plot, its ethereal fronds seeming to phase between states of existence as they settled into soil that had been blessed by his essence. The moment the herb made contact with its new environment, another cascade of information flowed across his consciousness.

|Transcendent Veilmoss successfully planted in Enhanced Early Cultivation Plot. Optimal growing conditions detected. Estimated time to maturity: 24 hours under current Shore enhancement levels. Expected yield: 300% of baseline harvest due to Early Creature blood infusion. Harvest window: 24-hour optimal period beginning at full maturity. Secondary shoots anticipated to develop Temporal Manipulation properties due to Shore’s unique authority signature.|
The Chronos Petrichor required even more delicate handling, its crystalline structure existing in multiple temporal states simultaneously.
As Noah placed it within its designated plot, he could feel time itself responding to the herb’s presence.

|Chronos Petrichor successfully integrated with Temporal-Enhanced Cultivation Plot. Warning: Herb exists in quantum temporal superposition. Maturation will occur across multiple timeline branches simultaneously. Estimated harvest readiness: 12 hours in standard timeline, with additional yields available from parallel growth cycles.|
Each subsequent planting brought its own revelations and promises.
|Void-Heart Chrysanthemums anchored...|
|Echo Sage successfully planted in...Maturation: 10 hours. Special attribute: Leaves will carry compressed experiences of Shore’s accumulated...|

|Infinity’s Breath Orchids established in Infinity-Resonant Cultivation Space. Growth enhanced by proximity to Sacred Totem of Infinity. Maturation: 12 hours with continuous bloom cycle thereafter...|
One after another, they were completed!
As Noah completed the planting process, he stood back to appreciate the vibrant plots of cultivated land that spread before him like a mosaic of compressed possibility!
The loose obsidian crown that hung at an angle on his head began to shine with inner radiance as Yoshinami responded to his satisfaction.
In the space of a heartbeat, her terrifyingly gorgeous figure materialized beside him with the fluid grace of a predator assuming perfect position.
She surveyed the farmland with crimson eyes that burned with ancient hunger, her pale features shining.

"Such beauty," she said, "needs to be painted and nurtured with seas of blood. Gardens flourish when watered with the essence of enemies, when fertilized with the compressed authority of those foolish enough to oppose their cultivator."
Her gaze shifted to Noah with predatory intensity, crimson orbs blazing with anticipation of violence yet to come.

"Master," she continued, her words dripping with honeyed malice, "whose blood will you have me spill? My threads are ready to bind and collapse existence itself. My webs hunger for prey worthy of their attention..."
The crimson eyes of Yoshinami flashed dangerously as she spoke, each word carrying within it the promise of True Death delivered to any who dared threaten what her master had built.
Noah smiled at her bloodthirsty enthusiasm and reached out to pat her head, his fingers running through dark hair that seemed to contain shadows deeper than the space between stars.

"You would scare the shit out of me if I had not bound you to my service," he said with genuine amusement, "but yes, through you, we will indeed spill blood. The threads of existence themselves will run crimson before we are finished."
In the distance, Heidrun observed this exchange with arrogant eyes that had grown wide with caution.

The magnificent goat began to slowly edge away from their position, her imperial bearing intact but clearly motivated by self-preservation instincts that warned her against remaining near two existences who she deemed a bit mental!

With the agricultural projects established and his deadly companion properly motivated, Noah turned his attention toward the distant figure of Moiraine. She sat in meditative stillness upon the golden sands, her form blazing with the accumulated light of Kleos Glyphs as she worked to forge additional protections.
"Alright," Noah called across the Shore, his voice carrying with crystalline clarity, "let us make our way toward the Transcendent Temporal Folds!"

As he spoke these words, his body began to divide with the precision of perfect symmetry. One became two, each form complete and perfect in its own right, carrying within it the full weight of his accumulated authority.
One body remained upon the Shore, ready to continue overseeing and increasing in power. The other prepared for departure to realms where Dead Existences challenged everything!

The departing body tapped upon the obsidian crown that adorned his head, causing Yoshinami’s figure to vanish with the fluid grace of shadow returning to its source. The crown responded to this action by flashing with inner radiance, its simple circlet form beginning to expand and transform with the sound of crystallizing possibility.
The obsidian material flowed across his body, covering him from head to toe in armor that emanated a dreadfully silent aura of power.
The transformation was both beautiful and terrifying to witness, each piece of the growing protection fitting into place!

The armor itself was archaic and ancient in its design. The obsidian surface held depths that seemed to contain entire Folds of darkness, while patterns of deep purple and gold traced across its structure in designs.

The helm that covered his head allowed only his vibrant eyes to remain visible. Around the visor, the glyph of a spider had been inscribed with masterwork precision, its lines pulsing with the promise of webs that could bind existence itself.

With such an imposing demeanor established, this armored body of Noah appeared near Moiraine’s position. She had already formed a second body of her own, her Kleos and Eminent Early Living Existential Glyphs shining with brilliant radiance as she prepared to display the terrifying scope of her newfound power.
The Early Veiled Shore pulsed with anticipation as, in the next moment, they disappeared entirely!
In the distance, the Sacred Totem Towers hummed with sympathetic resonance, while the crystalline waters continued their dance against shores that had been blessed by the blood of an Early Creature.

And in the cultivation plots where precious herbs grew in soil enriched by sacrifice and determination, the future continued to take root as all these resources...would only empower and elevate Noah’s existence in the near future!

chapters.title: Chapter 3984: Choices and Consequences! VI
paragraphs: As the bodies of Noah and Moiraine moved across the weavings of existence, their forms sliding through dimensions that existed parallel to normal existence, Noah maintained contact with Duke Gwendolyn.
Her guidance flowed through existence, directing their passage toward the Transcendent Temporal Folds where chaos bloomed like a flower of ending!
Yet even as this momentous convergence unfolded, another weaving of existence bloomed elsewhere.
In the Transcendent Spiritual Folds, where consciousness itself had been given form and substance.
Here, massive archaic white pillars rose from foundations that existed in multiple dimensions simultaneously.
These monumental structures stretched in all directions..up and down, left and right, forward and backward!
Between these impossible monuments, white tendrils of light swirled.
The very air seemed thick with compressed awareness, each breath containing fragments of memories that belonged to no single entity yet somehow felt familiar to anyone who dared to inhale them.
This was the place where spirits dwelt, where the essence of consciousness could exist independent of physical form, where thoughts themselves could take on lives of their own!
At this moment, near a swirling stellar cluster of light, the ethereal figure of a man could be seen floating with the grace of someone who had finally found his natural element.
The figure was composed of pure radiance given human shape, his form shifting between states of existence with each heartbeat.
Yet despite this ethereal nature, his features remained recognizable.
Pure light connected him to a few hundred other bodies that rotated around him like stars in a constellation dedicated to consciousness itself.
The man was none other than Eckert, the Great Usurper!
At this moment, his ethereal body burned with Living Spiritual Authority that flowed through his essence gloriously!
A prompt materialized before his consciousness with the gentle radiance of understanding finally achieved.

|Your existence has successfully adapted to and integrated Living Spiritual Authority through the transformative influence of the Seed of Existence. Fundamental metamorphosis complete. Classification updated: Living Spirit. All previous restrictions on existential manipulation have been removed.|
Another cascade of information followed immediately.

|Due to the aberrant nature of your existence and the System of Existence that defines your fundamental existence, two possible evolutionary paths have been identified: Path of Active Existence- Actively spread your Living Spiritual essence across the Folds, latching onto other Spirits and conscious entities, gradually devouring and usurping their existences until their awareness becomes extensions of your own will. This path offers rapid advancement through consumption of accumulated wisdom and power. Path of Transcendent Idleness - Embrace your true nature and remain in a state of perfect inaction, allowing the natural flow of existence to bring opportunities to you rather than seeking them through active effort. This path offers sustainable growth through harmony with Existence.|
WAA!
The Great Usurper gazed upon these two possibilities with the calm assessment of someone who had always known what his answer would be.
The choice between active consumption and perfect stillness was no choice at all...it was simply a confirmation of what he had always been at his core!
Was there even a need to ask?!
"I want to be idle," he declared with the serene certainty. "I want...to be free."
The moment these words left his consciousness, reality itself seemed to exhale.
A murky stellar white-black radiance erupted from his position with the force of a new Wheel being born, spreading outward in all directions for light-years.

|The Idle Gaming System is undergoing fundamental metamorphosis in response to your existence returning to its truest roots. All previous limitations and restrictions are being dissolved. New parameters established.|

|The Transcendent Spiritual Folds has been designated as a unique Living Existential Dungeon under capable of being influenced by your Idle Gaming System. This classification grants you unprecedented access to the accumulated consciousness and wisdom that flows through these Folds!|

|Idle Resource Generation Initiated: Every hour, you will automatically receive Loot directly related to the Weavings of Existence present within these Folds. Quality and quantity of Loot will scale based on the extent of your existential coverage within the domain.|

|Current Coverage- Your existence currently influences an unfathomably miniscule percentage of the total Fold structure. Coverage expansion will proceed through passive methods, your influence will spread naturally through simple proximity and time. Active Existential Parasitism remains available as an emergency option, usable once per day when immediate expansion is required.|
The ethereal form of the Great Usurper smiled as understanding bloomed within his transcendent consciousness.
His voice echoed across light-years of spiritual territory as he bellowed his acceptance of this ultimate destiny!
"Idle I shall be!"
HUUM!
Meanwhile, in the Transcendent Temporal Folds, where time itself had been given form and the rivers of causality flowed, a very different kind of transformation was taking place.
Near churning rivers of purple-blue Continuum that carried within their currents the compressed essence of past and future.
Duke Gwendolyn hovered above the temporal streams powerfully. Her stellar dark hair caught and reflected the light of flowing time, while her tan skin radiated warmth of terrible powerr.
Yet it was her eyes...those impossible orbs that resembled dozens of stacked Wheels of Existence...ah!

Behind her, arranged in formations, floated five hundred Honored Living Existences like a terrifying army of transcendent power. Each figure blazed with their own unique signature of authority, their combined presence creating waves of pressure that made the temporal rivers themselves flow faster in recognition.
Even further behind this magnificent display of power, ten thousand Prime Living Existences maintained their positions with the patient discipline.
The sight was breathtaking in its scope!
Beside Duke Gwendolyn floated a figure encased in obsidian crystalline armor that pulsed with Living Paradoxical Authority.

This was her other body, the manifestation of her ability to exist as both Origin and Paradox simultaneously, a living contradiction that somehow achieved perfect harmony through the simple act of refusing to acknowledge impossibility!
At this moment of perfect preparation, Duke Gwendolyn reached out, pinching the surrounding space between fingers that blazed with concentrated Living Origin Authority.

The fabric of existence responded to her touch like clay in the hands of a master sculptor, reality bending and twisting until it formed a wormhole that pulsed with energies drawn from every possible source of power.
From this impossible aperture, two figures emerged!
Noah floated forth in his stellar obsidian armament, the armor that Yoshinami had become flowing across his form like liquid darkness given purpose and direction.
Beside him, Moiraine appeared with the imperious bearing of a Paradoxical being!

Though her skin did not display the Kleos Glyphs that marked her ultimate achievements, anyone with sufficient sensitivity could feel the astounding power that radiated from her form...authority that no normal Honored Living Existence could ever hope to match.

Duke Gwendolyn’s ancient eyes sharpened as they focused upon Noah’s barely visible features, recognition flickering through her consciousness as she identified him. Her gaze then shifted to Moiraine, taking in every detail of the accumulated power that blazed from her transformed existence.
"You only have a single Honored Paradox in your employ?" she asked with calm precision. "She may not be able to change much in this battle, regardless of her apparent capabilities."
Noah smiled behind his concealing helm as he spoke.

"Underestimation is the cardinal sin of those who have grown comfortable with their accumulated power...the luxury of beings who believe that experience grants them perfect knowledge, that longevity ensures wisdom, that previous victories guarantee future success. The mightiest have fallen because they underestimated enemies they deemed beneath their notice! I know thr esteemed Duke would not possibly underestimate!"
HUUM!

chapters.title: Chapter 3985: The Blade of a Shore! I
paragraphs: Duke Gwendolyn listened to this impromptu monologue coldly. When Noah finished speaking, her response was delivered with cutting precision.
"You talk too much sometimes," she said, her voice carrying the weight of absolute dismissal.

Without allowing further discussion, she pointed toward distant regions of the vast Temporal Folds while ignoring his words, her gesture encompassing territories that stretched across light-years of twisted time and space.

"The situation is currently manageable and not entirely dire," she declared. "The forces of the Coalition of Living Existences are about to engage the Dead Existences in coordinated assault. The Living Origins have committed several Dukes to support, along with their accumulated forces."
As she spoke these words, Noah’s enhanced perception panned across the impossible scope of the Transcendent Temporal Folds.

In one direction, he sensed the aura of a terrifying Duke emanating from an entity that appeared as a pure white slime, its deceptively simple form radiating waves of power that made the surrounding rivers of time flow backward.
The being’s face...if the shifting mass of intelligent liquid could be said to possess such features, was filled with terrible power and arrogance!
Behind this Duke also floated a few hundred Honored Living Origins alongside several thousand Prime Living Origins.

In another direction, Noah’s awareness detected the presence of another Duke. This entity appeared as a titanic Imoogi that shone with pure gold radiance, its serpentine form coiled through dimensions!
Every scale that adorned its magnificent length pulsed with authority that could have served as the foundation for entire Wheels of Existence.
Like its counterpart, this Duke commanded similar armies...hundreds of Honored beings supported by thousands of Primes, all arranged with the precision.

As Noah’s perception continued to expand, he sensed other auras spread across distances so vast that they existed beyond the reach of observation. Each signature spoke to power that operated on the level of Dukes!
"Just how many Dukes were sent for this operation?" Noah asked, his voice carrying genuine curiosity.
"Information of that magnitude isn’t distributed so freely," she said, "Come on, let us observe the scope of what approaches."
With these words, she gestured toward the Living Existences that floated behind her in perfect formation, and the entire army began to move forward as one!
As they advanced toward the heart of the coming conflict, the very air began to carry new sounds....horrid screeches that seemed to originate from the concept of ending itself!
Simultaneously, the auras of terrible Dead Existences began to press against their consciousness like physical weights.
The vast scope of the approaching battle revealed itself with the gradual certainty of nightmare becoming very fucking real!
The forces of the Coalition of Living Existences had surrounded the eerie Dead Existences in a region that spanned light-years of twisted space-time.
Thousands upon thousands of Honored and Prime Living Existences floated in perfect coordination, their combined authority creating a siege that challenged the very concept of escape.
At the center of this impossible containment, a massive tear in existence itself pulsed with energies that made reality convulse in recognition of wrongness.
The wound in the fabric of space-time bled deathly authority in streams that transformed everything they touched, turning vibrant flows of temporal energy into stagnant pools of crystallized ending.
Near this fundamental violation of order stood the massive skeleton that had emerged most recently.
The entity’s presence emanated a terrible aura that seemed to exceed even that of normal Dukes.

Yet despite the overwhelming superiority of the forces arrayed against it, the skeleton remained perfectly still, its empty sockets gazing across light-years of space with the patient attention of someone evaluating prey rather than assessing threat.

The Dukes from different factions of Living Existences had positioned themselves around this region of the Temporal Folds, each one commanding their own forces while maintaining careful distance from the others!
Yet none had made any grand moves, all waiting for some signal or development that would trigger the beginning of systematic violence.

Noah gazed upon all of this immensity, and despite the magnitude of the forces involved, despite the significance of what was about to occur, he couldn’t help but feel a profound sense of exhilaration.
The possibilities were boundless!
Here was conflict on a scale unfounded, opportunities for advancement and understanding that stretched toward horizons he was only beginning to perceive.
As he absorbed had such thoughts, Moiraine moved closer to his position and sent a mental message.

’Master,’ her mental voice whispered with urgency, ’what is this? I sense immense danger from that obsidian skeleton...it could likely collapse my existence with a casual tap and unmake everything I have become through the simple act of noticing my presence!’
She spoke these words with the straightforward honesty of someone who had assessed her capabilities against those of the enemy and found the comparison lacking in every conceivable way!
Noah smiled at her concern, the expression hidden behind his helm yet somehow conveying reassurance.
"That skeleton won’t be your concern," he said with calm certainty, "Trust me."

With these words, he reached out to tap her head lightly, the gesture carrying with it a flood of information that flowed directly into her consciousness. Details about the current situation, the forces involved...all of it transferred through their connection with the speed of thought itself.
Moiraine absorbed this knowledge, and as understanding bloomed within her awareness, she nodded with stern determination.
Her hidden Kleos Glyphs pulsed with renewed radiance as she prepared herself for whatever role she would be called upon to play in the terrible wonder that was about to unfold!
Near them, Duke Gwendolyn released a sigh that carried the weight of eons.

"Too many...will die in the battle to come, and when any die under the hands of Dead Existences...they join them forever!" she said, her voice carrying genuine regret for the casualties that would inevitably result from the coming violence!

"Once the Dukes commit to action, the goal becomes swift elimination of that Primordial Death Duke", she gestured toward the skeleton whose presence commanded such careful attention, "followed by immediate closure of the tear in the Folds. Living Spirits, Temporals, Dimensionals, and Quantums will work in concert to seal the breach before any additional terrors can pass through."
Her gaze shifted between her own paradoxical body and Moiraine as she continued her tactical assessment.

"This Paradox in my employ, along with the one under your direction, will move to mitigate the damage our forces will inevitably receive since they are somewaht immune to the power of Dead Existences. We already know that the Dead Existences will overwhelm our front lines...so only Honored Living Existences will be permitted to engage them in close combat, while Primes will provide support from distance. And-...!"
Her words cut off abruptly as something impossible occurred with the suddenness of lightning striking clear skies.
The skeleton that had remained perfectly still throughout their approach, the Primordial Death Duke whose patience had seemed absolute, had suddenly made a move!

Yet the very nature of its action challenged every assumption about sequence and causality...the attack had not begun and then completed, but had somehow always been occurring while simultaneously having already arrived at its destination!
It was...fucking confusing!
Paradoxically. Inevitably. The strike would always arrive because it had already reached its target, yet it was also happening for the first time in this moment of crystallized now.
The assault struck out toward a distant region where Living Elementals had positioned themselves for the coming battle.

Across light-years of twisted space-time, a Duke who appeared as a mesmerizing Elemental Sprite found herself facing annihilation as a storm of deathly obsidian collapse descended upon her position with the intent to end all her beginnings, to unravel every thread that connected her to existence itself!
Yet in the next instant, five other Dukes materialized beside their threatened colleague with movements that transcended normal concepts of speed and distance!

The six beings erupted with Living Existential Authority, their combined power creating barriers of crystallized Existence that sought to negate the deathly force that pursued the systematic elimination of everything they represented!

At the same moment, the eerie Dead Existences that numbered in the thousands...beings whose heads remained raised toward skies that held no stars, whose mouths pulsed with the rhythm of entropy itself...began to move with the coordinated precision.
They flowed outward from their positions near the tear in reality, their movements carrying the inexorable certainty of tide coming in.
Each figure radiated authority that made the surrounding temporal rivers flow backward, their presence transforming the carefully maintained flows of causality into chaotic eddies!
It was the beginning of a terrifying battle.
One that truly... Noah did not possess the Raw power to participate in directly, to make grand changes through personal intervention alone.
Yet that simple limitation did not stop him from being here, from witnessing history unfold, from positioning himself to seize opportunities that others might overlook!
After all, the greatest victories were often achieved not through overwhelming force, but through perfect timing and the wisdom to recognize when small actions could produce vast consequences!

chapters.title: Chapter 3986: The Blade of a Shore! II
paragraphs: War.
War never changes.

Across the infinite expanse of existence, from the smallest conflicts between neighboring worlds to the cosmic struggles that determined the fate of entire Omniverses, the fundamental nature of war remained constant!
It was bloody. It was brutal. It was the crucible in which civilizations were tested and found either worthy of continuation or destined for the ash heap of forgotten history.
There were many different types of wars, with results that painted reality in shades of crimson and despair.
Death and decimation followed in war’s wake like faithful hounds, devouring everything that dared to stand in their path!
Some peace-loving souls would claim that there were no clear winners in such conflicts, that victory was an illusion maintained by those who counted corpses instead of measuring the cost to the soul.
But those naive idealists understood nothing of the true nature of power! Those peaceful hippies knew nothing.
War was bloody, yes. War was heavy with consequences that echoed across eons, certainly.

But it absolutely held victors...beings who stood atop countless corpses with the authority to defecate upon the remains of their enemies and choose to write history according to their will because they had won.
They had survived. They had conquered.
Those were the true victors, the ones who shaped reality according to their vision because they possessed the strength to impose their interpretation of events upon existence itself!

The ones who won wars most often rewrote history to their favor, transforming desperate struggles into glorious campaigns, brutal necessities into noble sacrifices, systematic extermination into righteous cleansing.
History belonged to the victorious, and the victorious could make it say whatever they deemed appropriate for their legacy.
So there were wars between conscious beings who understood concepts like mercy, honor, and strategic withdrawal.
And then...there were wars with Dead Existences.
They... had very different ideas about what victory entailed, concepts that challenged every assumption about conflict and resolution!

For them, victory was not conquest...it was consumption. It was digestion. It was not the imposition of will upon the defeated. It was the complete erasure of the very concept of defeat through the systematic elimination of everything capable of experiencing it!
When Dead Existences waged war, they sought to ensure that the very notion of opposition ceased to exist...
The War for the tear in the Temporal Folds and the Dead Existences that had emerged from realms of ending was unfolding on a scale that challenged comprehension itself.

Each point of contact between Life and Death produced results that rippled outward through dimensions, effects that occurred by the thousands simultaneously across a battlefield measured in light-years.
To truly understand the magnitude of what was transpiring, one had to narrow their focus to single points of conflict and work outward toward the grander scope of war.
The mind...even one enhanced by transcendent power, could not process the totality of such violence without being driven to madness by its sheer immensity!
This was what Noah was doing now as he observed the eerie and unfathomably silent Dead Existences rush outward from their breach in reality.
His enhanced perception focused on select points of impact, using them as windows through which to comprehend the broader patterns of systematic annihilation that unfolded around him.
Even as he concentrated on these tactical observations, his Refined Early Living Existential Glyph of Loot pulsed with steady rhythm, silently drawing golden bubbles of potential toward his position.

The spheres of compressed opportunity flowed from multiple sources...both the Living Existences who fought with desperate courage and the Dead Existences whose very destruction created new forms of valuable essence.
War, for all its horror, remained the most efficient generator of loot that existence had ever devised for him!
Among those he chose to observe, Noah began with the Living Origins who formed the backbone of Duke Gwendolyn’s forces.

His gaze settled upon an Honored Living Origin whose appearance spoke to authority given form and purpose. She wore pristine white robes that seemed to drink in the chaotic energies around her and transform them into patterns of perfect purpose, while nine white halos rotated around her head.
She appeared before a Dead Existence that resembled an apathetic skeletal orangutan, its massive frame radiating the kind of indifference that came from experiencing eons of unending torment!
The Living Origin shone with glory that made the temporal rivers flow faster. Behind her, a massive Tower of Origin flashed into existence.
But this was no simple tower like those forged by Originus Venerant entities!

This structure blazed with complexity that expressed countless intricate branches formed across its primary trunk, each one representing a different aspect of Origin that had been explored and mastered.
Explored. Mastered.

This was the mark of one who had achieved the Branching Ascendancy Realm, the vast stage that existed beyond Originus Venerant where beings learned to forge towers that incorporated multiple truths while maintaining their central focus.
Multiple truths...with a central focus!
The Branching Ascendancy Realm was itself divided into three distinct stages, each marking different levels of mastery and understanding.

The first stage, known as Initial Branching, occurred when a being successfully forged their first three branching towers from their central concept...if their main weaving was Origin, they might create branches for Origin of Fire, Origin of Light, and Origin of Time, each maintaining the fundamental nature of Origin while expressing it through different applications.
This was where Prime Living Existences stood most of the time. Initial Branching!
The second stage, Mature Branching, required the formation of nine complete branches, creating what was called...a Full Conceptual Tree!

This was where most Honored Living Existences found themselves, having achieved enough branches to gain resistances in multiple areas while forging their own unique interpretations of their central truth.

The third and most rarified stage was Perfect Branching, achieved when a being successfully created 27-81 branches...a Complete Branching Tower that could then be transformed through transcendent effort into something even greater- a Fold Garden.
A pocket dimension where their understanding of their central concept could be given physical form and used to nurture growth that transcended everything else.
The Branching Ascendancy Realm! Initial Branching, Mature Branching, Complete Branching!

The Honored Living Origin before him clearly possessed a Mature Branching Tower, her mastery evident in the way 9 branches spread from her central trunk in patterns that resembled a glorious Tree of Existence!

sentences.text: War.
War never changes.

Across the infinite expanse of existence, from the smallest conflicts between neighboring worlds to the cosmic struggles that determined the fate of entire Omniverses, the fundamental nature of war remained constant!
It was bloody.
It was brutal.
It was the crucible in which civilizations were tested and found either worthy of continuation or destined for the ash heap of forgotten history.
There were many different types of wars, with results that painted reality in shades of crimson and despair.
Death and decimation followed in war’s wake like faithful hounds, devouring everything that dared to stand in their path!
Some peace-loving souls would claim that there were no clear winners in such conflicts, that victory was an illusion maintained by those who counted corpses instead of measuring the cost to the soul.
But those naive idealists understood nothing of the true nature of power!
Those peaceful hippies knew nothing.
War was bloody, yes.
War was heavy with consequences that echoed across eons, certainly.

But it absolutely held victors...beings who stood atop countless corpses with the authority to defecate upon the remains of their enemies and choose to write history according to their will because they had won.
They had survived.
They had conquered.
Those were the true victors, the ones who shaped reality according to their vision because they possessed the strength to impose their interpretation of events upon existence itself!

The ones who won wars most often rewrote history to their favor, transforming desperate struggles into glorious campaigns, brutal necessities into noble sacrifices, systematic extermination into righteous cleansing.
History belonged to the victorious, and the victorious could make it say whatever they deemed appropriate for their legacy.
So there were wars between conscious beings who understood concepts like mercy, honor, and strategic withdrawal.
And then...there were wars with Dead Existences.

chapters.title: Chapter 3987: The Blade of a Shore! III
paragraphs: Each branch pulsed with its own variation of Origin...Origin of Brilliance, Origin of Protection, Origin of Purification, Origin of Judgment...multiple interpretations that allowed her to express her fundamental nature through whatever lens the situation required!
Her Origin was bright and undeniable, waves of accumulated Resistances flowing from her form like armor woven from compressed possibility.
She possessed her own designed Absolute Resistance, the ultimate defense that came from perfect understanding of her central concept.
Yet when she moved to impose her definition of Origin upon the Dead Existence before her, the creature’s response was both simple and devastating!
The skeletal orangutan made a single motion...a gesture of negation so pure and fundamental that it seemed to deny the very concept of beginning.
As its bony hand moved through space, a dried tower filled with death flashed behind its form, the structure appearing like a diseased mockery of everything the Living Origin represented.
This tower of ending was composed of branches as well, but where hers celebrated life and possibility, its extensions spoke only to different methods of termination.
Branch of Slow Death, Branch of Instant Dissolution, Branch of Existential Erasure...countless variations on the theme of ending that challenged every assumption about growth and advancement!
The collision between these opposing concepts sent shockwaves through the surrounding space as Origin met its antithesis in head-on confrontation.
For a moment that stretched across heartbeats, the two forces remained locked in perfect balance, neither able to gain advantage over the other.

Then the Dead Existence’s curse-enhanced power began to assert itself, its fundamental advantage over Living Existential Authority becoming apparent as the tower of endings slowly but inexorably began to negate the brilliant tree of Origin that sought to impose itself upon reality!

The expression of the Honored Living Origin changed drastically as she witnessed her perfect mastery being systematically unraveled by forces that operated according to principles she could not fully comprehend.
"YAA!"

She bellowed with desperate fury, her Origin expressing itself with all the glory she could muster, light erupting from her form in waves that should have been sufficient to obliterate entire Wheels of Existence!
HUUM!
Yet even this magnificent display proved insufficient against the cursed nature of her opponent.
In the next moment, multiple other Living Origins materialized near her position with movements that spoke to desperate coordination rather than planned strategy.
They recognized what she faced, understood the fundamental disadvantage that any single Living Existence confronted when opposed by the cursed power of the Dead.

Only when a total of ten Honored Living Origins had positioned themselves around the skeletal creature, their combined authority layering their purpose and their undeniable beginnings into a symphony of existence affirmed, were they able to begin pushing the Dead Existence back and overwhelming its darkness!
Ten against one. Ten beings whose power could have conquered entire Wheels with a thought, required to face a single enemy whose very nature challenged their right to exist.
The wonders of this conflict were staggering and terrifying in their implications!

Noah’s eyes flashed sharply as his enhanced vision captured similar scenes occurring throughout the vast battlefield. In the distance, he observed Living Laws circling a single Dead Existence like predators attempting to bring down prey far larger than themselves, their combined efforts barely sufficient to begin cutting across the deathly authority that surrounded their target.
Cutting across something cursed to be endlessly tormented with endless death required tremendous amounts of Origin, Law, Spirit, Paradox, or the other terrifying Living Weavings of Existence!
Each wound inflicted healed almost immediately, each binding imposed was countered by the fundamental nature of beings that existed in states of perpetual ending.
It was at this moment of tactical assessment that Noah felt the time had come for his own forces to join the fray.
His own...singular force.
He turned toward Moiraine with eyes that blazed with tyrannical anticipation, his voice carrying across the space between them with crystalline clarity.
"My dear Moiraine," he said with casual confidence, "let loose!"
HUUM!
The effect of his words was immediate and profound.
Moiraine’s visage began to shine with brilliant radiance as the allure of Paradox flared outward from her position like waves of compressed impossibility.
The sight was both beautiful and unsettling!

Many Living Existences in the surrounding area sensed the distinctive signature of Paradoxical Authority and turned their attention toward her with expressions that ranged from distaste to open hostility.

Her clear origination from the region where Duke Gwendolyn floated in grandly observational authority provided some measure of protection, but it was evident that most observers regarded this display with emotions that fell far short of approval.

The hatred that Living Existences held for anything connected to Paradox ran deeper than personal preference or tactical assessment...it was fundamental loathing born from eons of suffering consequences that stemmed from Paradoxical interference in the natural order.
But Moiraine paid no attention to these hostile gazes as her body flashed.
Her target was a massive humanoid titan among the Dead Existences, its form composed of what appeared to be crystallized endings given shape and malevolent purpose.
The creature’s head remained raised toward skies that held no stars, its mouth pulsing with rhythms that spoke to absorption rather than communication.
It drew in all surrounding weavings of existence like a void given consciousness, its very presence creating dead zones where the fundamental forces that governed reality simply ceased to function.

Now, when any single Living Existence moved to face a Dead Existence in direct confrontation, protocol...so far at least, demanded that others nearby would immediately join them to ensure the numbers reached at least ten.
This was not cowardice but practical necessity...the requirements for victory against cursed opponents demanded overwhelming force applied with perfect coordination.
Yet as Moiraine charged forth alone, her aura of Paradox blazing with unmistakable clarity...nobody joined her advance.
Nobody!

Living Origins floated nearby and watched with cold indifference, their expressions suggesting they were observing a particularly unpleasant form of entertainment rather than witnessing a potential ally in mortal peril.

Others actively chose to assist Living Origins at distant positions who already had groups of three or four supporters, deliberately avoiding the opportunity to provide aid to the solitary Paradox who had dared to engage in combat within their vicinity.

Out of all the Living Existences present in the immediate area, only Moiraine...the Living Paradox whose very nature was an affront to their sensibilities...was about to face a Dead Existence entirely alone!
