chapters.title: Chapter 3988: The Blade of a Shore! IV
paragraphs: Her body radiated no obvious waves of terrifying power, no manifestations of authority that would have warned observers they were witnessing something beyond normal capability.
Her identity as a Paradox was clear and unmistakable, yet this revelation carried negative rather than positive implications for those who observed her advance.

Even though she moved without support, even though she faced odds that should have resulted in immediate annihilation, her voice rang out with declarations that spoke to certainty rather than desperation.
"I am mighty!" she voiced with grand authority that made the surrounding temporal streams flow faster in recognition of truth being proclaimed.
HUUM!
The words carried weight that transcended their simple meaning, each syllable backed by power that had been earned through sacrifice and transformation!
Even though she approached her target alone, even though common sense demanded she wait for support that would never come, she continued her declarations with growing intensity.
"I am his blade!" she said, her voice taking on notes of devotion that spoke to loyalty beyond the reach of doubt or fear.
The statement was personal...she was not merely a weapon to be wielded. She was the manifestation of someone’s will given form and directed purpose!

Even though isolation marked her as abandoned by those who should have stood beside her, even though the hostile gazes of her supposed allies promised only contempt for whatever fate awaited her, she completed her proclamation with words that rang across the battlefield like a law being established.
"I am his Arch. I am...MOIRAINE!"
WAA!
The declaration erupted from her with such force that reality itself seemed to take notice, temporal rivers shifting their flow to accommodate her!
At such words, she moved to face the Dead Existence head-on in a scene that nearby Living Existences observed with expressions of cold satisfaction.
They did not see any flash of a Branching Tower rising behind her to provide support and tactical advantage.
They witnessed no manifestation of the normal seas of Paradoxical Authority that characterized how Paradoxes typically expressed their power in combat situations.

They saw only Moiraine approaching the massive Dead Existence with casual confidence, her small hand beginning to swipe downward toward the enormous bony fist that the creature raised to crush her out of existence.

The contrast in scale was almost comical...a relatively small figure moving to intercept a blow that could have shattered mountains, her delicate hand positioned to meet bone that radiated deathly authority capable of unmaking entire civilizations.

"Dumbshit Paradox," a distant voice belonging to a Living Spirit echoed across the battlefield, the words carrying the particular contempt reserved for beings whose stupidity exceeded all reasonable bounds.
"Who does she think she is to fight among us?" The voice of a Living Elemental joined the chorus of derision, hatred dripping from each syllable like acid eating through hope itself.

"Best to die early," came the most damning assessment of all, delivered by a Living Origin from the very armies that served under Duke Gwendolyn’s command. "Maybe a decent Inevitability or Living Collapse will arise from her death that isn’t completely imbecillic."

The sentiment was shared by many present...Paradoxes were not merely disliked...they were actively despised by other Living Existences, their very existence seen as a contributing factor to the endless proliferation of Inevitabilities that made progress toward the Loom so achingly difficult.

Years of conflicts and accumulated resentment had crystallized into hatred so pure it transcended rational assessment, becoming an emotional constant that influenced every interaction between Paradoxes and other Living Existences!

So at this moment, none cared for Moiraine’s welfare, and many actively hoped for her swift death. Perhaps from her ending would arise more useful forms of chaos, Inevitabilities that would serve some greater purpose rather than representing yet another example of Paradoxical incompetence.

This was the universal sentiment that greeted her desperate charge...not support or encouragement, and instead anticipation of failure and death delivered with the casual cruelty of beings who had long since ceased to view Paradoxes as worthy of basic consideration!

Noah gazed at all these reactions with eyes that buzzed with tyrannical coldness, his enhanced perception taking in every hostile expression, every dismissive comment, every casual wish for his chosen companion’s destruction.
Yet he only stared coldly and remained silent, offering no defense or explanation for what was about to unfold.
Sometimes, one did not need to speak.
Sometimes, results spoke far more eloquently than any words ever could.

As Moiraine’s fair hand came down upon the massive rising fist of the Dead Existence, something extraordinary occurred that challenged every assumption the observers had made about her capabilities and limitations.
A seemingly simple Glyph flashed briefly on her palm...just for an instant, barely visible even to enhanced perception.

That was all. No large outburst of authority, no wild manifestation of Paradoxical energy, no desperate surge of Living Existential Authority seeking to overwhelm superior opposition through sheer volume of power.
Just a flash of something that most observers couldn’t even identify, a brief illumination that passed so quickly it might have been imagination.
And yet...
CRACK!
The massive thrown fist of the Dead Existence, wrapped in obsidian waves of death that should have been sufficient to unmake anything they touched, shockingly shattered like glass meeting diamond!
Not just damaged or deflected...completely destroyed, the entire appendage dissolving into fragments that scattered across dimensions like ash on stellar winds.
The result defied every law of probability and power that governed such conflicts!
Why would such an outcome surprise anyone who truly understood what had just occurred?

As a Paradox, Moiraine was not affected by the Curse that enhanced Dead Existences beyond normal parameters, her very nature providing immunity to the fundamental advantage that made such creatures so devastatingly effective against other types of Living Existence.

More importantly, she had not relied upon Living Existential Authority in her attack...instead, she had employed an Early Living Existential Glyph, a tool and expression of power that was normally utilized exclusively by Early Creatures themselves.
And not just any Glyph, but a Kleos Glyph...the ultimate expression of power that transcended every normal category of capability.
And not merely any Kleos Glyph, instead one whose nature was grander still...the Kleos Glyph of Paradoxical Genesis!

Paradoxical Genesis...the authority to create beginning from paradox, to forge possibility from impossibility, to establish new existences through the simple act of refusing to acknowledge that such existences should be impossible!
In the next moment, a level of brutality unfolded that left even the confused Dead Existence struggling to process what was occurring to its carefully maintained form of crystallized ending.
Moiraine’s body flashed to multiple positions around her target with movements that transcended normal limitations of space and time.
Without apparent cost of energy or authority, she activated her Kleos Glyphs simultaneously, each one blazing with power that made reality convulse!

The meaning of Paradoxical Genesis asserted itself against the seemingly undeniable weavings of Death that comprised the Dead Existence’s core nature. Where the creature represented ending made manifest, Moiraine imposed the concept of beginning renewed... the transformation of conclusion into commencement through methods that defied rational comprehension.

The Dead Existence’s body began to shatter and compress under this assault, its deathly Existential Authority being systematically smashed and decimated in a manner that no other Living Existence present had been capable of achieving!
The cursed enhancements that made such creatures nearly invulnerable proved useless against power that operated according to principles the Curse was in tune with!

In a single second that contained within it the compressed essence of perfect violence, Moiraine used her hands...flashing with Glyphs that remained invisible to normal perception, to brutally tear apart the Dead Existence with her own physical strength.

She moved like a primal archaic creature unleashed upon prey that had never learned to fear predators of her magnitude, her actions speaking to savagery that had been refined into perfect efficiency through understanding rather than mere instinct!

"OOOH!" she yelled as she completed her work, waving her hand in a gesture that caused the entire corpse of the Dead Existence to vanish into dimensional storage where it could be properly processed and utilized.

The event was utterly shocking to witness...a single Paradox accomplishing what should have required ten coordinated Living Existences, doing so with such casual efficiency that the entire confrontation lasted less than the time required to draw breath.

Moiraine looked up from her completed task and gazed at all the Living Existences who had observed her advance with such cold indifference, who had actively wished for her death rather than offering support that could have prevented potential tragedy.
For them, she had only two words that carried the full weight of her contempt for their cowardice and prejudice.
"Fucking trash."
Oh!

Noah gazed at all these reactions with eyes that buzzed with tyrannical coldness, his enhanced perception taking in every hostile expression, every dismissive comment, every casual wish for his chosen companion’s destruction.
Yet he only stared coldly and remained silent, offering no defense or explanation for what was about to unfold.
Sometimes, one did not need to speak.
Sometimes, results spoke far more eloquently than any words ever could.

As Moiraine’s fair hand came down upon the massive rising fist of the Dead Existence, something extraordinary occurred that challenged every assumption the observers had made about her capabilities and limitations.
A seemingly simple Glyph flashed briefly on her palm...just for an instant, barely visible even to enhanced perception.
That was all.
No large outburst of authority, no wild manifestation of Paradoxical energy, no desperate surge of Living Existential Authority seeking to overwhelm superior opposition through sheer volume of power.
Just a flash of something that most observers couldn’t even identify, a brief illumination that passed so quickly it might have been imagination.
And yet...
CRACK!
The massive thrown fist of the Dead Existence, wrapped in obsidian waves of death that should have been sufficient to unmake anything they touched, shockingly shattered like glass meeting diamond!
Not just damaged or deflected...completely destroyed, the entire appendage dissolving into fragments that scattered across dimensions like ash on stellar winds.
The result defied every law of probability and power that governed such conflicts!
Why would such an outcome surprise anyone who truly understood what had just occurred?

As a Paradox, Moiraine was not affected by the Curse that enhanced Dead Existences beyond normal parameters, her very nature providing immunity to the fundamental advantage that made such creatures so devastatingly effective against other types of Living Existence.

More importantly, she had not relied upon Living Existential Authority in her attack...instead, she had employed an Early Living Existential Glyph, a tool and expression of power that was normally utilized exclusively by Early Creatures themselves.
And not just any Glyph, but a Kleos Glyph...the ultimate expression of power that transcended every normal category of capability.
And not merely any Kleos Glyph, instead one whose nature was grander still...the Kleos Glyph of Paradoxical Genesis!

Paradoxical Genesis...the authority to create beginning from paradox, to forge possibility from impossibility, to establish new existences through the simple act of refusing to acknowledge that such existences should be impossible!
In the next moment, a level of brutality unfolded that left even the confused Dead Existence struggling to process what was occurring to its carefully maintained form of crystallized ending.
Moiraine’s body flashed to multiple positions around her target with movements that transcended normal limitations of space and time.
Without apparent cost of energy or authority, she activated her Kleos Glyphs simultaneously, each one blazing with power that made reality convulse!
The meaning of Paradoxical Genesis asserted itself against the seemingly undeniable weavings of Death that comprised the Dead Existence’s core nature.

Where the creature represented ending made manifest, Moiraine imposed the concept of beginning renewed... the transformation of conclusion into commencement through methods that defied rational comprehension.

The Dead Existence’s body began to shatter and compress under this assault, its deathly Existential Authority being systematically smashed and decimated in a manner that no other Living Existence present had been capable of achieving!
The cursed enhancements that made such creatures nearly invulnerable proved useless against power that operated according to principles the Curse was in tune with!

In a single second that contained within it the compressed essence of perfect violence, Moiraine used her hands...flashing with Glyphs that remained invisible to normal perception, to brutally tear apart the Dead Existence with her own physical strength.

She moved like a primal archaic creature unleashed upon prey that had never learned to fear predators of her magnitude, her actions speaking to savagery that had been refined into perfect efficiency through understanding rather than mere instinct!

"OOOH!" she yelled as she completed her work, waving her hand in a gesture that caused the entire corpse of the Dead Existence to vanish into dimensional storage where it could be properly processed and utilized.

The event was utterly shocking to witness...a single Paradox accomplishing what should have required ten coordinated Living Existences, doing so with such casual efficiency that the entire confrontation lasted less than the time required to draw breath.

Moiraine looked up from her completed task and gazed at all the Living Existences who had observed her advance with such cold indifference, who had actively wished for her death rather than offering support that could have prevented potential tragedy.
For them, she had only two words that carried the full weight of her contempt for their cowardice and prejudice.
"Fucking trash."
Oh!

chapters.title: Chapter 3989: Let it be a festival! I
paragraphs: Fucking trash!
The assessment was delivered with such casual precision that it struck those who heard it like a whip!
And none truly had a viable reply against it because they had truly acted like trash!
Then, Moiraine turned her attention toward the broader battlefield where Dead Existences continued their systematic assault upon the forces of the Living.

At this moment, multiple creatures that had been engaged with other opponents suddenly disengaged from their current battles and began moving toward her position with the focused attention of predators recognizing a threat that required immediate elimination.
The sight of Dead Existences abandoning positions to converge upon a single target sent waves of shock through the Living Existences who had witnessed her impossible victory.

They struggled to process what she bad done. Could they truly be sensing the authority of an Honored Living Paradox!? How had she managed to accomplish what even coordinated groups of their number found challenging?
Off to the side, Duke Gwendolyn watched this entire sequence unfold with eyes that shone with blazing interest.
Her other body...the one that operated as a veiled Paradox, had not yet made any moves in the broader battle, but she found herself compelled to observe Moiraine!
She turned toward Noah with her ancient gaze, her voice echoing out.
|Is she really just an Honored Living Paradox?|, came the carefully phrased question.
Noah gazed at her with eyes that remained calm and cold, his mental response delivered with tyranny.
|What else could she be?| he replied, the mental equivalent of a shrug accompanying words that dismissed her inquiry as fundamentally irrelevant to larger concerns.

The simplicity of his response, combined with the evidence they had all just witnessed, left Duke Gwendolyn with far more questions than answers about the true nature of the beings she had agreed to work alongside!
Yet as Dead Existences began converging on Moiraine’s position with focused attention, all such considerations became secondary to the immediate situation unfolding before them.
Noah observed everything with crystal clarity, his perception processing the vast scope of conflict that unfolded across light-years of twisted space-time.
He knew, that in this grand battle between Life and Death, the direct effect he could have through personal intervention was minimal!

His accumulated power, impressive though it was by the standards of most Living Existences, would not be sufficient to eliminate even a single Dead Existence. Each of these cursed entities operated at the Honored level of capability, their advantages making them nearly invulnerable to attacks of even normap Honored Living Existences.

More critically, if he positioned himself close enough to directly engage any Dead Existence that might target him, Yoshinami’s Crown of Inevitable Retribution would activate with devastating precision!

The protective artifact would deliver True Death to any attacker whose power fell below that of an Early Creature or one wielding a Lost Forgotten Principle...conditions that would waste its precious single daily usage on enemies that could be eliminated through easier means.
In a conflict of this magnitude, such waste would be tantamount to suicide.

So in this terrifying battle that would determine the fate of fundamental forces across existence itself, he would have to approach victory through methods that transcended brute force application of personal power.
He already had an idea forming in the depths of his consciousness, a strategy that would leverage his unique capabilities in ways that others could never hope to replicate.

His gaze settled upon Moiraine’s figure as multiple Honored Dead Existences began converging on her position with the focused attention of predators. The creatures moved with eerie coordination, their heads still raised toward skies that held no stars, yet their direction clearly oriented toward the Living Paradox who had dared to destroy one of their number through methods they could not fully comprehend.

Across the broader battlefield, similar scenes unfolded. Dead Existences radiated terrifying power as they engaged the forces of the Living, their cursed weavings allowing them to systematically overwhelm opponents who should have possessed superior numbers.

Casualties had begun to occur among the Living Existences with shocking frequency, particularly when two or three Dead Existences managed to surround smaller groups of defenders. The weavings of such encounters were unforgiving...even coordinated teams of ten Honored Living Existences found themselves struggling.

Yet the Living Existences maintained numerical superiority through careful deployment and strategic reserves. When one fell, two more immediately took their place, their formations flowing like liquid around points of resistance with the fluid grace of forces that had been drilling such maneuvers across eons of preparation.

Meanwhile, the massive tear in space-time remained stable in its current configuration, no additional Dead Existences emerging from thr domain where ending reigned supreme. The number of enemies they faced was finite, limited by whatever constraints governed travel between the domains of Life and Death.
If the current rate of attrition continued, the Dead Existences would eventually be eliminated! But the cost would be tremendously high!

Duke Gwendolyn and the other Dukes who commanded this unprecedented coalition seemed to understand this grim weaving perfectly, their expressions growing heavier with each passing moment as they witnessed the price that victory would demand.
It was such a dreadful reality!
Noah smiled behind his concealing helm as he contemplated this situation, his thoughts turning towards his own weavings.
’Don’t worry,’ he mused with the kind of benevolent arrogance, ’Since I am so magnanimous, I will make this easy for all of you!’
HUUM!
The moment this thought crystallized into decision, Noah closed his eyes and reached inward toward the architectural wonders that existed within the depths of his own being.

He called upon the more than one hundred and fifty Towers of Osmont that rose like monuments to impossible achievement from the foundation of his early Atlas, each one blazing with accumulated authority that had been refined through methods that predated current existence!

Memory stirred as he recalled the previous occasion when multiple towers had sung Hymns, their combined weavings acting to emulate the presence of multiple Early Creatures gathered for common purpose.
Such convergence had triggered the Festival of Existence that had covered the Nullvein Gravewake Folds with its transformative influence...effects that continued to express themselves even now!

chapters.title: Chapter 3990: Let it be a festival! II
paragraphs: That original festival had been born from basic Towers of Origin, primitive structures that had served their purpose before being systematically replaced with something infinitely grander.

In their place, he had forged the Towers of Osmont...monuments to advancement that were supported by Early Sacred Living Eidolons, massive glorious statues that provided foundations capable of channeling forces that normal towers could never hope to accommodate!

What would happen when these vastly superior structures began singing their hymns? Would the result still be classified as a mere Festival of Existence, or would the grandeur of his upgraded towers produce something that transcended every previous category?
He already knew the answer, and the musings filled him with anticipation that bordered on euphoria.
He thought about it once more as he would make a move that would forever change many things. And he found that even after all the caution, his decision remained the same!

Noah smiled internally as he turned his attention toward a particular aspect of his existence, one that preferred to observe silently while plotting and planning, emerging only when circumstances absolutely necessitated grand gestures that could reshape the nature of whatever situation demanded attention.
"Why don’t you wake up, buddy?" he said, his words directed toward the personified concept that had always represented his most outrageous capabilities.
He was, of course, addressing Cheats...the force within his existence that had consistently delivered results that defied every rational expectation about what should be possible.

Inside the architectural marvel that comprised his inner existence, where the Early Atlas stretched toward completion like a map of infinite possibility, the very concept of Cheats blazed with brilliance that made Existence take notice!
The Early Sacred Living Cheats Tower of Osmont shone with radiance, its crystalline surfaces reflecting not light but pure potential given form and purpose.

The structure rose from foundations that existed in multiple dimensions simultaneously, each level representing a different aspect of what it meant to achieve the impossible through methods that challenged every assumption about limitation and consequence!

Above this manifested tower, visible only to Noah’s enhanced inner perception, sat the personified concept of Cheats itself...a figure that embodied everything he had ever achieved through audacious application of principles that others deemed impossible.

The entity possessed an appearance that seemed to shift between different interpretations of what ultimate capability should look like, sometimes appearing as a masterful conductor preparing to direct a symphony of glory, other times manifesting as an architect!
At this moment, as Noah’s request reached the depths of where this concept dwelt, the figure began to make grand movements with solemnity.

|Cheats has proceeded to commandeer sufficient nutrients from the devoured body of the compressed Inevitability to secure advancement and thorough standing to the Second Stage of its Tower of Osmont.|

|Cheats has initiated the Symphony of Hymns of the Early Sacred Living Eidolons encompassing all Towers of Osmont. Direction protocols have been established with clear purpose- harmonic flow shall not emanate from primary source but will instead permeate from the selected target designated as Arch Living Existence Moiraine. Redirection complete. Symphony preparation finalized.|
HUUM!
The moment these processes reached completion, Moiraine’s body began to buzz with frequencies that transcended normal understanding of sound or vibration.
A cacophony of glorious symphony began to resound from her form....not chaotic noise, and instead perfectly orchestrated harmony!

The music that emanated from her position was both beautiful and terrifying, each note carrying within it the compressed essence of authority that had been refined across eons of impossible advancement- archaic and tribal!

Yet the true wonder was occurring within Noah’s existence, where architectural marvels that would have required dozens of Early Creatures working in coordination began to resonate with each other in patterns that had not been witnessed since the Earliest Folds.
The Dead Existences that were charging toward Moiraine’s position suddenly felt the sensation of something foreign intruding upon their carefully maintained states of endless torment!
For the first time since their emergence from realms of ending, they actually paused in their advance.

More shocking still, their heads...which had remained raised toward non-existent skies in perpetual absorption of surrounding existence, slowly turned downward to truly look at the source of these impossible harmonies.
They gazed upon Moiraine with what might have been recognition, as if some buried aspect of their cursed consciousness remembered when such music had last been heard across the breadth of existence.
The Living Existences nearby also stopped their desperate maneuvers, shock flooding through their enhanced perceptions as they felt glorious hymns resounding through the very fabric of reality!
The music carried within it effects that could influence their own quantified Weavings of Existence.
Noah smiled within his concealing armament, satisfaction flooding through his consciousness as he witnessed the first stages of his strategy unfold according to design.
"Let it be a festival," he murmured to himself with the quiet confidence of someone who had calculated every variable and found them acceptable.
"Let it be glorious. Let it be that even though I do not currently possess the raw power to participate directly in this conflict...my glory will still shine the brightest on this battlefield!"
HUUM!
The moment those words finished forming in his consciousness, reality itself began to respond to the unprecedented convergence of forces that he had orchestrated.
|A glorious Festival of War is blooming under your direction!|
A festival!
But it was not of Existence...it was a Festival of War!

|Early Festivals of War were legendary gatherings that occurred when multiple powerful Early Creatures converged to begin their great hunts across the countless Folds and everything that existed between them. These festivals represented the ultimate expression of coordinated Early Creature might, events that unleashed their already shocking power to even greater limits through harmonic resonance that challenged the fundamental nature of limitation itself. The last Festival of War in recorded history was forcibly ended when THE Living Law made a decisive move using something that could systematically decimate the power of Early Creatures, bringing the age of unfettered Early Creature dominion to its conclusion through methods that remain entirely unknown.|

chapters.title: Chapter 3991: Let it be a festival! III
paragraphs: |A unique Early Festival of War has been triggered through the guiding hands of Cheats, modified with unprecedented parameters that reflect the singular nature of its orchestrator. The range of this festival will affect the immediate region of conflict where it first blooms, encompassing all entities contained within designated boundaries.|

|Festival Modification: The Blessing of the Perfidious Glyph will be applied to all qualifying existences within the affected region. This blessing grants the extraordinary ability for complexity and purity of affected targets to express their accumulated power through Perfidious Glyphs...constructs that imitate a fraction of the fundamental authority wielded by Early Creatures themselves.|

|Additional Enhancement: Under the guiding influence of Cheats and thr shake down from Loot, any entities eliminated through power enhanced by this festival will have 1% of their total existence automatically siphoned as loot and passively granted to the being who ushered in the festival. Furthermore, the rate, usage, and expression of Living Existential Authority for all affected beings will be amplified by 500%, creating combat capabilities that transcend normal limitations.|
Oh!
Oh!!!

A terrifying blessing that masqueraded as beneficent assistance...the kind of gift that promised transcendencs while simultaneously ensuring that the true beneficiary would be the one who had orchestrated its manifestation!
At this moment, glorious symphonies of hymns echoed outward from Moiraine’s position with the inexorable force of existential law being established.
The glorious symphony permeated across the surrounding region, touching every consciousness capable of perceiving their magnificence!
Every Living Existence who heard these symphonic wonders found themselves marked by an illusory sigil that materialized above their heads...two golden swords crossing in patterns.
The moment such markings appeared, the affected beings felt their existence buzz with terrifying power that challenged every assumption they held about their own capabilities and limitations!

Those who had been struggling desperately against Dead Existences suddenly felt their accumulated authority converging into singular expressions of force that they did not fully understand yet instinctively knew how to wield.

Only Noah possessed sufficient knowledge to truly observe what was occurring as his enhanced perception catalogued the flashing of Perfidious Glyphs that proceeded to strike Dead Existences with unprecedented effectiveness.

For the first time since the battle had begun, the cursed creatures showed signs of genuine damage rather than merely temporary inconvenience. Their forms convulsed as authority that imitated Early Creature power tore through defenses that had been designed to withstand Living Existential Authority.
Noah smiled brilliantly at this vindication of his strategic approach, satisfaction flooding through his consciousness like liquid starlight.
Many eyes turned toward Moiraine in shock as the impossible harmony continued to resound from her position, yet she kept her head straight and her focus clear.

Though she understood that this phenomenon was not of her own creation, that it stemmed from his unfathomable capabilities, she simply proceeded forward toward the Dead Existences that now regarded her with something approaching solemnity.
’O Sir.’
Even though she faced ahead, her voice echoed out in Noah’s mind!
’I know not why you chose me for this position, but I will thank you in...my own way after this is done, Sir.’
Her words were explosive as her ’Sirs’ could drive lesser men to have weak legs!
Noah kept a straight face as he only smiled and hummed, thinking how much bolder and freer Moiraine was becoming from how she acted after she found out he was an Early Creature.
He refocused on the Dead Existences as other matters came later!

The cursed creatures no longer moved with the casual confidence that had marked their earlier advances. Instead, they approached with the careful attention of beings who recognized they faced something powerful.

Above Duke Gwendolyn’s position, the blessing manifested as well, her ancient consciousness reacting with surprise as she felt her own carefully controlled existence respond to influences that were foreign.
She looked toward both Moiraine and Noah with an unfathomable glow burning within her eyes, recognition beginning to dawn that she was witnessing something...else.
And her focus...came to be more on Moiraine than Noah at this moment. And why the hell not when her body boomed with a terrific symphony?!

The pace of the entire battle had shifted with shocking suddenness as glorious symphonies echoed across the battlefield and every Living Existence in the affected region gained blessings that elevated their capabilities far beyond normal limitations.

This enhancement extended even to the Dukes who were actively engaging the terrifying Primordial Death...the massive skeletal entity whose power had required multiple Duke-level beings working in perfect coordination merely to withstand its assaults.
Throughout all of this unprecedented transformation, Noah’s figure remained nonchalant in the center of the chaos he had orchestrated.

Despite having just executed a maneuver that entirely changed the pace of the battle and would determine how its results unfolded, despite establishing himself as the beneficiary of every enemy eliminated through enhanced power...he maintained the appearance of casual observation rather than active participation.
There were many ways that one could influence the outcome of a war, but the method Noah had chosen was one that could not be replicated!
So he floated grandly above the transformed battlefield, seemingly making no moves yet actually serving as one of its most critical commanders.
His hands clasped behind his back in a pose of imperial observation, he gazed upon the uniquely unfolding conflict with the satisfaction of someone whose vision had been perfectly implemented.
He had to do this as the aura of the Protagonist had to shine brightly even while he simply observed!

The symphony continued to build toward crescendos that promised even greater revelations, while golden markers above countless heads blazed with authority that transformed desperate struggle into systematic superiority.

In the distance, Dead Existences began to fall with increasing frequency as enhanced Living Existences discovered that their elevated capabilities could actually inflict permanent damage upon enemies that had previously seemed invulnerable!
And with each elimination, each systematic destruction of cursed entities that had dared to emerge from realms of ending...
|A piece of the bone of an Honored Dead Existence has been obtained and funneled to the Early Veiled Shore for classification and quantification.|
|The occipital bone of an Honored Dead Existence has been obtained and funneled to the Early Veiled Shore for classification and quantification.|
|A piece of the vile heart of an Honored Dead Existence filled with an unknown curse has been obtained and funneled to the Early Veiled Shore for classification and quantification.|
Prompts began to roll it one after another as Noah’s eyes blazed with tyranny!
Yes.
Move more.
Work more!
Grant him even more glory!
The festival was just beginning, and already its effects promised to echo across eons of consequence yet to unfold!

The range of this festival will affect the immediate region of conflict where it first blooms, encompassing all entities contained within designated boundaries.|
|Festival Modification: The Blessing of the Perfidious Glyph will be applied to all qualifying existences within the affected region.

This blessing grants the extraordinary ability for complexity and purity of affected targets to express their accumulated power through Perfidious Glyphs...constructs that imitate a fraction of the fundamental authority wielded by Early Creatures themselves.|

|Additional Enhancement: Under the guiding influence of Cheats and thr shake down from Loot, any entities eliminated through power enhanced by this festival will have 1% of their total existence automatically siphoned as loot and passively granted to the being who ushered in the festival.
Furthermore, the rate, usage, and expression of Living Existential Authority for all affected beings will be amplified by 500%, creating combat capabilities that transcend normal limitations.|
Oh!
Oh!!!

A terrifying blessing that masqueraded as beneficent assistance...the kind of gift that promised transcendencs while simultaneously ensuring that the true beneficiary would be the one who had orchestrated its manifestation!
At this moment, glorious symphonies of hymns echoed outward from Moiraine’s position with the inexorable force of existential law being established.
The glorious symphony permeated across the surrounding region, touching every consciousness capable of perceiving their magnificence!
Every Living Existence who heard these symphonic wonders found themselves marked by an illusory sigil that materialized above their heads...two golden swords crossing in patterns.
The moment such markings appeared, the affected beings felt their existence buzz with terrifying power that challenged every assumption they held about their own capabilities and limitations!

Those who had been struggling desperately against Dead Existences suddenly felt their accumulated authority converging into singular expressions of force that they did not fully understand yet instinctively knew how to wield.

Only Noah possessed sufficient knowledge to truly observe what was occurring as his enhanced perception catalogued the flashing of Perfidious Glyphs that proceeded to strike Dead Existences with unprecedented effectiveness.
For the first time since the battle had begun, the cursed creatures showed signs of genuine damage rather than merely temporary inconvenience.
Their forms convulsed as authority that imitated Early Creature power tore through defenses that had been designed to withstand Living Existential Authority.
Noah smiled brilliantly at this vindication of his strategic approach, satisfaction flooding through his consciousness like liquid starlight.
Many eyes turned toward Moiraine in shock as the impossible harmony continued to resound from her position, yet she kept her head straight and her focus clear.

Though she understood that this phenomenon was not of her own creation, that it stemmed from his unfathomable capabilities, she simply proceeded forward toward the Dead Existences that now regarded her with something approaching solemnity.
’O Sir.’
Even though she faced ahead, her voice echoed out in Noah’s mind!
’I know not why you chose me for this position, but I will thank you in...my own way after this is done, Sir.’
Her words were explosive as her ’Sirs’ could drive lesser men to have weak legs!
Noah kept a straight face as he only smiled and hummed, thinking how much bolder and freer Moiraine was becoming from how she acted after she found out he was an Early Creature.
He refocused on the Dead Existences as other matters came later!
The cursed creatures no longer moved with the casual confidence that had marked their earlier advances.
Instead, they approached with the careful attention of beings who recognized they faced something powerful.

Above Duke Gwendolyn’s position, the blessing manifested as well, her ancient consciousness reacting with surprise as she felt her own carefully controlled existence respond to influences that were foreign.
She looked toward both Moiraine and Noah with an unfathomable glow burning within her eyes, recognition beginning to dawn that she was witnessing something...else.
And her focus...came to be more on Moiraine than Noah at this moment.
And why the hell not when her body boomed with a terrific symphony?!

The pace of the entire battle had shifted with shocking suddenness as glorious symphonies echoed across the battlefield and every Living Existence in the affected region gained blessings that elevated their capabilities far beyond normal limitations.

This enhancement extended even to the Dukes who were actively engaging the terrifying Primordial Death...the massive skeletal entity whose power had required multiple Duke-level beings working in perfect coordination merely to withstand its assaults.
Throughout all of this unprecedented transformation, Noah’s figure remained nonchalant in the center of the chaos he had orchestrated.

Despite having just executed a maneuver that entirely changed the pace of the battle and would determine how its results unfolded, despite establishing himself as the beneficiary of every enemy eliminated through enhanced power...he maintained the appearance of casual observation rather than active participation.
There were many ways that one could influence the outcome of a war, but the method Noah had chosen was one that could not be replicated!
So he floated grandly above the transformed battlefield, seemingly making no moves yet actually serving as one of its most critical commanders.
His hands clasped behind his back in a pose of imperial observation, he gazed upon the uniquely unfolding conflict with the satisfaction of someone whose vision had been perfectly implemented.
He had to do this as the aura of the Protagonist had to shine brightly even while he simply observed!

The symphony continued to build toward crescendos that promised even greater revelations, while golden markers above countless heads blazed with authority that transformed desperate struggle into systematic superiority.

In the distance, Dead Existences began to fall with increasing frequency as enhanced Living Existences discovered that their elevated capabilities could actually inflict permanent damage upon enemies that had previously seemed invulnerable!
And with each elimination, each systematic destruction of cursed entities that had dared to emerge from realms of ending...
|A piece of the bone of an Honored Dead Existence has been obtained and funneled to the Early Veiled Shore for classification and quantification.|
|The occipital bone of an Honored Dead Existence has been obtained and funneled to the Early Veiled Shore for classification and quantification.|
|A piece of the vile heart of an Honored Dead Existence filled with an unknown curse has been obtained and funneled to the Early Veiled Shore for classification and quantification.|
Prompts began to roll it one after another as Noah’s eyes blazed with tyranny!
Yes.
Move more.
Work more!
Grant him even more glory!
The festival was just beginning, and already its effects promised to echo across eons of consequence yet to unfold!

chapters.title: Chapter 3992: Deterioration! I
paragraphs: The battle erupted with newfound intensity as the Symphony echoing outward from Moiraine’s position seemingly energized every Living Existence within its range!
The golden markers above their heads blazed with authority that transformed desperation into determination, while their enhanced existence flowed through their beings.
They swarmed toward the Dead Existences with fervor that bordered on religious ecstasy!
At the center of this transformation, Moiraine herself proceeded to face five oncoming Dead Existences with calm confidence.

The creatures approached her position with the eerie synchronization that marked their cursed nature, their forms radiating deathly authority that should have been sufficient to overwhelm any individual opponent!

Each Dead Existence possessed the accumulated power of Honored-level capability enhanced by tge curse that elevated them far beyond normal limitation, their very presence creating zones where the forces of life simply ceased to function.
Yet Moiraine moved toward them without hesitation, her hands beginning to flash with barely visible illumination!
Her first target was a humanoid creature whose skeleton seemed to be composed of crystallized endings, each bone pulsing with the rhythm of entropy itself.
As it raised massive arms to crush her out of existence, Moiraine’s delicate hand intercepted the descending limb calmly.

The moment her flesh made contact with cursed bone, a Kleos Glyph flashed across her palm...invisible to normal perception yet radiating authority that made reality itself take notice. The creature’s arm unraveled at a fundamental level, its very essence being rewritten!

Before the first Dead Existence could even process what was occurring to its carefully maintained form, Moiraine had already moved to engage the second. This entity appeared as a writhing mass of void given shape, its presence creating tears in space-time through which glimpses of realms of absolute nothingness could be observed.
Her response was to plunge both hands directly into its core, her fingers blazing with the invisible authority of Paradoxical Genesis!

Where the creature represented absence made manifest, she imposed the concept of presence renewed... the transformation of void into substance through methods that defied rational comprehension. It was paradoxical...and filled with purpose!

The Dead Existence convulsed as its fundamental nature was systematically inverted, void becoming solid, absence transforming into overwhelming presence that challenged every assumption about what such creatures could experience.

The remaining three Dead Existences converged upon her position simultaneously, their coordinated assault creating overlapping fields of deathly influence that should have been sufficient to unmake anything caught within their confluence.

Moiraine’s response was to laugh with genuine joy as she leaped into the center of their formation, her form becoming a blur of motion that left afterimages trailing through different spatial dimensions, her hands striking out as Kleos Glyphs flashe!

Each movement of her hands left devastating impacts upon her opponents, Kleos Glyphs flashing in patterns too complex for normal perception to follow as she systematically dismantled entities whose power had been refined through eons of cursed existence!
She moved like a primal creature unleashed upon prey that had never learned to fear predators of her magnitude, her actions showing savagery that had been elevated to the level of perfect art.
Within moments, all five Dead Existences lay in pieces around her position, their forms reduced to component elements that disappeared into her bodt right after!

Her brutal efficiency in eliminating opponents that required coordinated teams to handle had captured attention from across the battlefield, shock and recognition flowing through the consciousness of every observer who witnessed her impossible victories.
In the next few seconds, one Living Existence after another began to materialize near her position as she prepared to charge toward additional targets.
They maintained careful distances...close enough to provide support, far enough to avoid interfering with her devastating effectiveness.
Now they began to fucking show up!
Two Honored Living Temporals appeared first, their forms wreathed in purple-blue authority that bent causality around their presence.

They moved to intercept Dead Existences that were attempting to flank Moiraine’s position, their temporal manipulations creating zones where the cursed creatures found themselves trapped in loops of consequence that prevented effective retaliation.
Living Origins followed, their brilliant radiance creating barriers of compressed existence!
Living Spirits materialized as ethereal forms, while Living Concepts imposed abstract limitations that confused!

Living Laws arrived, their presence establishing zones where the chaotic nature of Dead Existence authority was forced to operate according to comprehensible rules rather than the arbitrary principles that governed realms of ending.

Undoubtedly, even though none of these Living Existences spoke directly to Moiraine, even though their previous interactions had been marked by hostility and dismissal, they now positioned themselves behind her with the coordination of beings who understood exactly what was at stake.

They recognized that the Symphony empowering them all emanated from her position, that her survival was directly linked to their enhanced capabilities. She could not be permitted to die, regardless of their personal feelings about Paradoxes in general or her specific identity in particular!
Noah observed all of this transformation with cold analytical eyes, his perception observing every shift in positioning while his consciousness processed everything.
How easily beings could cast aside hatred when survival and treasure hung in the balance, he mused with a kind of cynical amusement.
Prejudice became secondary to practical necessity when the alternative was systematic elimination by forces that recognized no distinction between different types of Living Existence.
Self-interest, it seemed, remained the most reliable constant across all forms of conscious behavior!

Even as he observed these dynamics unfolding, his attention remained partially focused on the cascade of information that continued to flow across his consciousness through channels that connected him to the Early Veiled Shore.
The prompts became even more detailed as he began to obtain more pieces of Dead Existences!

|Fragment of Dead Existence Cranium obtained. Estimated composition: 47% Crystallized Ending, 31% Compressed Deathly Authority, 22% Cursed Bone Essence. This specimen has been automatically transferred to the Early Veiled Shore for analysis and potential cultivation. Unique properties detected: Contains fragments of memories from the realm of absolute conclusion.|

|Segment of Dead Existence Ribcage acquired. Analysis indicates: 52% Ossified Entropy, 29% Concentrated Void Essence, 19% Temporal Decay Fragments. Transfer to Early Veiled Shore completed. Special notation: Ribcage segments retain echoes of the last breaths drawn by beings consumed during the creature’s cursed existence.|
|Complete Dead Existence Hand harvested. Composition breakdown...|
The prompts came and came!
The accumulation of such materials represented resources that could be utilized for advancement in ways that others could never hope to replicate.

As Noah processed these acquisitions while simultaneously observing the situation unfolding around Moiraine’s position, his eyes flickered with recognition of something that demanded immediate attention.
He turned toward Duke Gwendolyn, his consciousness reaching out to deliver a warning.
|You may want your other body to make a move now,| he conveyed.

A moment later, reality itself seemed to convulse as the distant figure of the Primordial Death...the massive skeletal entity whose power had required multiple Dukes to merely withstand, suddenly employed the concept of endings in a manner that challenged every assumption about distance and proximity.

The creature didn’t move in any conventional sense. Instead, it ended the distance between its current position and Moiraine’s location, instantly manifesting directly in front of her and the Living Existences who had gathered to support her advance!
The transition was so abrupt, so fundamentally wrong in its violation of spatial limitations, that reality itself seemed to recoil from acknowledging what had occurred.

One moment the Primordial Death had been engaged with Dukes across light-years of battlefield; the next, it loomed over Moiraine with obsidian bones radiating authority that could unmake entire Wheels through casual gesture!

chapters.title: Chapter 3993: Deterioration! II
paragraphs: It seemed as though immense calamity would descend upon the forces that had gathered around the source of their enhancement, that the being responsible for their empowerment would be eliminated before their eyes through methods they possessed no capability to prevent or counter!
But in the next moment, two figures moved with synchronized precision.

The veiled Paradoxical body of Duke Gwendolyn materialized beside the Primordial Death with movements that challenged causality itself, her obsidian armor blazing with authority that made space-time bend around her presence.

Simultaneously, her Living Origin body appeared on the opposite side of the massive creature, brilliant radiance erupting from her form in waves that should have been sufficient to illuminate entire Folds!
Duke Gwendolyn’s philosophical approach to this crisis demonstrated mastery of how opposing forces could be reconciled through will and wisdom.

Her Paradoxical aspect reached out to rewind an inevitable ending...not preventing the Primordial Death’s arrival, but creating a state where its presence existed in quantum superposition between having occurred and remaining theoretical possibility.
At the same moment, her Origin body worked to establish the previous state of existence that had existed before the creature’s arrival, imposing the concept of restoration!
The collision between these opposing interpretations of what should be considered real created a zone of fundamental uncertainty that even the Primordial Death found difficult to navigate.
Its cursed authority, designed to operate within weavings where ending was the only constant, struggled to function effectively in space where beginning and conclusion existed simultaneously.

Under the enhanced capabilities granted by Noah’s Festival of War, Duke Gwendolyn’s combined efforts proved sufficient to push back the Primordial Death, forcing the creature to retreat from its advantageous position through application of force that should have been impossible for just two Dukes to achieve!
The sight of 2 entities...even one as formidable as a Duke, successfully repelling the massive skeletal horror sent shockwaves through every consciousness present.
Other Dukes rushed toward this position with movements that left brief tears in reality.
Their sharp gazes moved between Duke Gwendolyn and the veiled Paradoxical figure that seemed to move under her direct command, questions forming in their ancient minds.

Yet none of them voiced these concerns immediately. The current crisis demanded coordination rather than interrogation, and with the Symphony empowering all of them, they possessed a genuine opportunity to eliminate the Dead Existences entirely and seal the tear in space before additional reinforcements could arrive from realms of ending!
Information could wait until victory had been secured and the immediate threat neutralized.
Noah observed all of these developments with cool analytical detachment.
His gaze locked upon the massive distant figure of the Primordial Death as it repositioned itself following Duke Gwendolyn’s successful repulsion.

If that being attempted to eliminate him specifically and not Moiraine, Yoshinami’s Crown of Inevitable Retribution would activate with devastating precision, delivering True Death to an enemy whose power operated at the level of Dukes.
But it did not target him.
And this possibility represented one of his primary strategic objectives for participating in this conflict...the opportunity to eliminate threats that normally existed beyond his capability.
As he tracked the creature’s movements with predatory interest, his attention was simultaneously drawn to another Duke who had positioned himself near the tear in space-time.
This entity appeared as a figure wreathed in pure white radiance, his form carrying two magnificent swords that blazed with crystalline authority.
Yet another swordsman in these grand weavings of existence!

The Duke representing Living Laws raised his weapons toward the massive wound in reality, brilliant illumination gathering around his blades as he prepared to deliver a weaving that would seal the breach through application of undeniable juridical force!
His voice echoed out as seas of Living Law gushed out from his swords!

"Immutable foundation of existential order. Unwavering pillar of absolute truth. Bind that which seeks to break. Seal that which refuses structure. Command the chaos to kneel. Iron chains of inevitability. Converge. Restrict. Embrace the weight of existential law and submit to its glorious dominion!
HUUM!
He intoned with voice that carried the weight of law being established, white light beginning to weave itself around the edges of the tear.
The incantation built toward crescendos that made reality itself respond, white light beginning to stitch the edges of the wound in space-time as undeniable law imposed itself.
The tear was about to close!
Yet just as this elaborate binding reached near completion, just as success seemed within reach through application of ultimate juridical authority...
BOOM!
Noah’s eyes pulsed with alarm as he witnessed a massive obsidian chain shoot out of the tear with speed...speed that was utterly terrifying!

The horrific chain was meant to collapse the Living Law Duke before his sealing could be completed, its surface wreathed in deathly authority that promised systematic unmaking of everything it touched. The terrifying Law barely managed to evade complete annihilation, yet even his partially successful evasion came at tremendous cost...half of his body shattered into obsidian dust upon contact with the cursed weapon, his form becoming translucent as he paled and retreated from his position near the tear.
From the breach in reality, eight more massive chains emerged with the sound of entropy being given physical form.
Behind them, pushing through the expanding wound in space-time, came something that challenged every assumption about what horrors could emerge from realms of ending.

The massive head of an obsidian entity appeared....the manifestation of absolute conclusion given the appearance of twisted innocence. It resembled a baby’s head scaled to impossible proportions, its features carrying the kind of wrongness!

The torn rift expanded even further as this abomination forced its way through, reality stretching and warping around its passage until the breach became large enough to accommodate additional horrors.

Behind the first nightmare, two more figures of Primordial Deaths began to peek through the expanded opening...entities whose power rivaled or exceeded that of the skeletal entity that had already emerged, their presence promising escalation into a catastrophe!

All Dukes who observed these developments paled with grimness. If this situation continued to deteriorate according to current patterns, they would be forced to call upon additional collective forces.
The tear absolutely had to be closed before the situation became truly unmanageable, before the breach grew large enough to accommodate the invasion of forces that devoured everything!
Yet as the assembled Dukes turned grim with recognition of approaching calamity, Noah looked upon these developments with excitement that bordered on euphoria.

This was exactly the kind of opportunity he had been positioning himself to exploit...the emergence of enemies whose power operated at levels that would trigger Yoshinami’s ultimate protection while simultaneously providing him with resources that could elevate his capabilities tremendously!
He prepared to move forward, to position himself within the line of sight of these monstrous creatures whose authority operated at the level of Dukes.
Any one of them would do!
Any one!
If they attempted to eliminate him, their death would be guaranteed!
So he moved to ensure such confrontation at this most perilous moment, anticipation flooding through his consciousness.
And yet...

One could plan and prepare for every conceivable eventuality, could calculate variables and probabilities with the precision of destiny, could position resources and capabilities with strategic perfection that accounted for every foreseeable development.

But at the end of all such preparation, through means that no amount of foresight could control or predict, things possessed an inexorable tendency to deviate from expected patterns in ways that challenged even the most comprehensive planning!
Because right after Noah began his advance toward optimal positioning...
BOOM!
Shit hit the fan.

This was exactly the kind of opportunity he had been positioning himself to exploit...the emergence of enemies whose power operated at levels that would trigger Yoshinami’s ultimate protection while simultaneously providing him with resources that could elevate his capabilities tremendously!
He prepared to move forward, to position himself within the line of sight of these monstrous creatures whose authority operated at the level of Dukes.
Any one of them would do!
Any one!
If they attempted to eliminate him, their death would be guaranteed!
So he moved to ensure such confrontation at this most perilous moment, anticipation flooding through his consciousness.
And yet...

One could plan and prepare for every conceivable eventuality, could calculate variables and probabilities with the precision of destiny, could position resources and capabilities with strategic perfection that accounted for every foreseeable development.

But at the end of all such preparation, through means that no amount of foresight could control or predict, things possessed an inexorable tendency to deviate from expected patterns in ways that challenged even the most comprehensive planning!
Because right after Noah began his advance toward optimal positioning...
BOOM!
Shit hit the fan.

chapters.title: Chapter 3994: Trembling! I
paragraphs: The sound that erupted from above transcended normal categories of auditory experience, carrying within it the compressed essence of impossibility being given voice and direction.
Waves of powerful Paradoxes pierced through the temporal fabric of the Folds themselves, their entrance defying every weaving of Existence!
They appeared by simply deciding that they had always been present, their arrival rewriting history to accommodate their sudden manifestation!
Their grand paradoxical entrance caused all beings...Dead and Living alike, to turn their attention skyward.
At the forefront of this impossible assembly flew a figure whose presence commanded attention through sheer magnitude of accumulated authority.
It was none other than...Diviticus.
Fucking Diviticus!
Diviticus, no longer merely Honored, but elevated to the rank of Duke!
Her form blazed with brilliant white and black radiance while her fair features bore an enticing tattoo that resembled a terrifying Glyph inscribed directly into her flesh.
The marking pulsed with its own inner radiance. This was not mere decoration but the manifestation of authority that had been permanently integrated into her very essence!
Behind Duke Diviticus, the assembled might of Living Paradoxes created a display that rivaled the most magnificent conquering armies in the annals of history.

Duke Elagabalus floated with the casual arrogance that marked him as someone whose power had never been successfully challenged, his obsidian-gold hair flowing like liquid metal while his robes seemed to absorb and reflect light paradoxically.
Honored Gold maintained his position with ancient dignity.
Other terrifying Dukes of the Living Paradoxes arranged themselves in formations!

Yet silently behind all of these magnificent displays of transcendent capability stood a figure that appeared almost mundane by comparison...a man whose appearance suggested nothing more threatening than a beggar who had wandered into places far beyond his comprehension.

This was Duke Schrodinger, and his presence in the far back of their formation did nothing to diminish the profound sense of danger that radiated from his position like heat from a forge dedicated to remaking the fundamental nature of existence itself!

The moment he arrived, Noah felt his danger senses respond with intensity that bordered on panic. Diviticus did not make him feel danger. Nor did Honored Gold or any other Paradoxes. So why the fuck did he feel a sense of immense danher from that begger in the back?
At this shocking entrance of Living Paradox leadership, Diviticus stepped forward with movements that made reality convulse in recognition.

A terrifying aura eclipsing that of many Dukes erupted from her transformed form, waves of compressed impossibility smashing toward the emerging Primordial Deaths with menacing precision as she roared with voice that carried across dimensions.
"I! DIVITICUS! HAVE! ARRIVED!"
The declaration rang through the battlefield, each word carrying within it the compressed essence of everything she had become through methods that...others did not currently know about.
Through power that was not...entirely hers!
BOOM!

An apocalyptic impact erupted from her position, the shockwave of her presence alone proving sufficient to smash back all three Primordial Deaths that had been attempting to emerge from the expanded tear in reality.

Other Duke-level Paradoxes layered their own seas of paradoxical authority outward, creating overlapping fields of impossible force that sought to drown the creatures of ending in contradictions they could not resolve or escape.
Paradoxical Authority, as had been demonstrated again and again throughout the conflict, proved most effective against Dead Existences.

The arriving Paradoxes systematically pushed the Primordial Deaths back into the tear through application of coordinated impossibility, their combined efforts forcing entities that rivaled Dukes in power to retreat from realms where life still dared to exist.
Yet the true demonstration of transcendent capability came when the beggar-like figure from the rear of their formation appeared at the center of the tear itself.
Duke Schrodinger raised his hand with casual precision, pinching empty space between fingers that blazed with authority too subtle for normal perception to detect.
As he performed this simple gesture, his voice carried across the battlefield with the calm precision of someone delivering inevitable conclusion...in a voice that almost seemed bored!

"Fracturing mirror of simultaneous truths. Vessel of contradictory certainties. Exist and cease in unified opposition. Collapse all possibilities into singular choice. Dancing shadows of maybe and never. Quantum throne of impossible decisions. Self-negating crown of definitive uncertainty. Merge. Contradict. Accept the wisdom of paradox and bend to my selected Existence. In the state where all possibilities exist simultaneously, I choose the one where this wound...has never been opened. So. Existence...conform to my selection."
HUUM!
A pinch of empty space. A short incantation delivered with casual confidence.
And yet in the next moment, with speed that challenged every assumption about cause and effect...
WAP!

The tear sealed itself instantly, reality responding to paradoxical command by retroactively deciding that the wound had never existed in the first place. Space-time rearranged itself to accommodate this new interpretation of events, the massive breach simply ceasing to be!
The beggar-looking entity whose casual gesture had accomplished what multiple Dukes working in coordination had failed to achieve caused Noah to become unfathomably serious.

The moment Duke Schrodinger completed his reality-altering intervention, the ancient being turned with movements that seemed to compress eons of accumulated attention into a single moment of focused scrutiny.
His eyes locked onto none other than Moiraine with intensity that made the surrounding space convulse.
Not just him. Duke Elagabalus, Honored Gold, and the vibrant Duke Diviticus all turned to gaze at her with expressions that carried cold calculation mixed with profound interest.
They knew that she...was the only remaining link to Ozymandias! Someone who likely had the inheritance of an Early Creature!

At this moment, Diviticus appeared above the cold-faced skeletal Primordial Death...the only creature that remained from the original incursion, her presence casting shadows that seemed to absorb light rather than merely blocking it.

Terrifying obsidian power leaked from her transformed form as she looked around at the surrounding Living Existences, her gaze taking in the assembled might of the Coalition while her voice carried across the battlefield with the weight of declaration.

"It seems...." she said with calm precision that made reality itself lean in to listen more closely, "that it is time for Living Paradoxes to also secure a seat at the table of governance across the folds."
She delivered these words while gazing directly at the other Living Existences who had gathered to witness this unprecedented resolution.
She spoke while looking specifically at Moiraine.

Her entrance, and the entrance of the Paradoxes as a unified force, had been nothing short of grand. They had appeared at the moment of greatest crisis and resolved the most pressing problems with efficiency!
Now, with the tear sealed and the primary threats neutralized, all that remained was cleanup of the remaining Dead Existences, and yet it seemed like things had gotten even messier!

chapters.title: Chapter 3995: Trembling! II
paragraphs: When things did not go according to plans, when the carefully calculated variables suddenly shifted in ways that challenged every assumption about control and consequence, one could only reassess the new parameters, adapt to changing circumstances, and overcome whatever obstacles had emerged through application of wisdom rather than force!
The entry of the Living Paradoxes had been unexpected, their grand display of power even more so.
These were not the desperate interventions of allies seeking mutual benefit!
This was the calculated arrival of forces.

But even against this unprecedented development, Noah felt his consciousness shifting through familiar patterns of analysis and adaptation that had served him through countless trials across his impossible journey.

He looked at Diviticus through a lens that had grown cold with recognition and calculation, seeing her not as she appeared in this moment of triumph but as she would exist in futures that stretched toward horizons only he could perceive!

She was someone he had deemed would definitely perish under his hands when circumstances permitted such resolution...she was already dead, she simply remained ignorant of this fundamental truth about her ultimate destiny!
But the question that burned through his consciousness with increasing intensity was how she had become so devastatingly powerful in such a relatively brief span of time.
She had consumed half a drop of his blood during their encounter in the Paradoxical Folds, that infinitesimal portion of his essence that had granted her immunity to producing Inevitabilities.

Yet if half a drop could produce such magnificent results, if such a tiny fragment of his being could transform someone into a force capable of challenging Dukes, then why was his own accumulated power not measured in trillions of Complexity and Purity Quotients rather than the hundreds of millions he currently possessed?
The inconsistency gnawed at his understanding.

Noah then recalled what the Paradoxes had recently accomplished through their audacious assault on the Coalition’s most protected facility...the theft of a Corpse of an Early Creature that had been jealously guarded for eons.

Was this the source of her newfound capabilities? Had the combination of his blood and access to the preserved remains of one of his kind created synergistic effects that transcended what either component could achieve individually?
Noah felt instinctive certainty crystallizing around this theory.

If he had obtained that corpse himself, if those preserved remains had been processed through the mystical mechanisms of his Early Veiled Shore rather than whatever crude methods the Paradoxes had employed...
The possibilities that stretched from such speculation were intoxicating in their scope and magnitude.
But someone else had claimed that prize.
Through their own power and audacity, certainly, but his blood had been a critical factor in making such theft possible.

Without his essence flowing through Diviticus, without the immunity and enhancement that half a drop had provided, the Paradoxes would never have been able to penetrate defenses that had held firm for eons.

A feeling began to settle in the depths of his consciousness...the sensation of losing prized loot that he had never actually possessed, watching someone else play with treasures that should have been his by right!

It was like witnessing a rival embrace a lover who should have been his own, hugging that precious loot to sleep and performing unspeakable acts of intimacy while he could only observe from positions of enforced isolation.
After all, in existence, nothing was worse than stolen loot!
Diviticus had made herself the center of attention at this moment of existential significance, positioning herself as the architect of victory.
Her display of power against the skeletal Primordial Death that had required multiple Dukes working in coordination to merely withstand was nothing short of domination!

She raised her hand with precision, fingers moving in patterns that seemed to rewrite the fundamental nature of space around her position. Tendrils of obsidian authority erupted from her transformed form, flowing outward like liquid darkness.
Yet these were not the crude manifestations of Paradoxical Authority that Noah had observed from other Living Paradoxes. The tendrils carried within them something older, more refined.
Noah’s enhanced perception detected the subtle musings of Glyphs woven throughout that authority!
The tendrils she released moved with predatory intelligence, seeking to wrap around the massive form of the Skeletal Primordial Death with the inexorable certainty of entropy given purpose.

The creature fought back with silent fury, its accumulated power creating zones where the fundamental forces of existence simply ceased to function, yet its countless manifestations of ending found themselves systematically cornered by authority that operated according to principles it could not counter!

Gradually, inexorably, the Primordial Death became bound by forces that transcended its cursed nature, its movements growing more restricted with each passing moment as Diviticus demonstrated mastery!
It was at this moment of tactical supremacy that Diviticus chose to address the assembled forces.

Her voice carried across the battlefield with crystalline clarity, each word chosen with the precision of someone who understood exactly what effects her speech would produce among her diverse audience.

"Ladies and gentlemen," she began, "we find ourselves witnessing something that has not occurred since the Earliest Folds...the emergence of Dead Existences in numbers and power sufficient to challenge all Living Existences. "
WAA!
She gestured toward the bound Primordial Death.

"What we have seen here today is not an isolated incident, not some random breach in the barriers that separate Life from Death. This is the beginning of something far more significant...a systematic invasion that will spread across every domain where consciousness dares to exist."
Her voice took on notes of grim certainty as she continued her analysis.

"Dead Existences of this magnitude will appear in many other locations, and with far greater frequency than we have witnessed today. The barriers that THE Creature established to keep our domains separate are failing, and when they collapse entirely, only Living Paradoxes will possess the fundamental advantages necessary to face such enemies effectively."

During her monologue, the Symphony emanating from Moiraine’s position continued to resonate across the battlefield, its effects now extending to encompass the newly arrived Paradoxes. Above their heads appeared the same golden markers that blessed other Living Existences...two crossed swords that blazed with authority beyond normal limitation.

The newly arrived Living Paradoxes and Dukes responded to this enhancement by unleashing terrifying seas of Paradoxical Authority upon the remaining Honored Dead Existences, their coordinated assault clearing the cursed creatures like cattle being systematically processed through mechanisms designed for efficient elimination.

"Just as in the Earliest Folds," Diviticus continued, her voice rising with the passion of someone delivering truth that others preferred to ignore, "the true enemies of Living Existences are not each other, but the forces of ending that seek to consume everything we have built through eons of careful cultivation and advancement."
She paused, allowing this fundamental realization to settle among her audience before delivering her ultimate objective.

"It is time for Living Paradoxes to reclaim our rightful seat at the table. We offer our capabilities gladly in the fight against Dead Existences, seeking partnership in facing threats that transcend every previous category of danger."
HUUM!

As Diviticus finished her carefully crafted monologue, she also completed the process of binding the skeletal Primordial Death entirely, her authority wrapping around the creature until it could no longer move or resist the forces that held it in perfect stasis.

The demonstration was complete...she had single-handedly accomplished what multiple Dukes working in coordination had struggled to achieve, while simultaneously positioning herself as the voice of reasonable cooperation in facing existential threats!
